nav.defensiveDriving.clearSpace.0.descri.text:
• Ukugcina isikhala esivulekile nxazonke zemoto yakho ngaso sonke isikhathi kusho ukuthi uqhela ezintweni ezingase zidale ingozi, futhi uzinika isikhala sokunyakazisa imoto nokusabela.
  • Uma udlula enye imoto, ushintsha imizila noma ungena emgwaqweni, ungaphambuki ungene eduze kakhulu phambi kwabanye. Ngena ushiye isikhala esanele ngemuva noma ngaphambi kwezinye izimoto.

nav.defensiveDriving.clearSpace.1.descri.text:
• Uma ulandela enye imoto, shiya ibanga lokulandela elilingana nemizuzwana engu-2.
  • Ukuze uthole ibanga lakho lokulandela, vumela imoto ephambi kwakho idlule into enganyakazi, njengesigxobo sesibani noma uphawu eceleni komgwaqo, bese lapho idlula ubala kancane uthi 'Umzuzwana owodwa, imizuzwana emibili'. Imoto yakho kufanele idlule leyo nto lapho uqeda ukuthi 'imizuzwana emibili'.
  • Ibanga langempela liyahluka kuye ngesivinini: uma uhamba ngesivinini esikhulu, ibanga lokulandela elilingana nemizuzwana emibili lisho ukuthi usalela emuva kakhulu kwenye imoto. Uma uhamba kancane, ibanga lokulandela lisalingana nemizuzwana emibili, kodwa usuke useduze kakhulu nenye imoto.
  • Ibanga lokulandela likunika isikhathi sokusabela. Uma imoto ephambi kwakho ibhuleka kungazelelwe, kuba nokubambezeleka okuncane ngesikhathi ubuchopho bakho bubona lokhu, bunquma ukubhuleka, unyawo lwakho lucindezela ibhuleki bese imoto ima.
  • Uma imoto yakho ithwele umthwalo osindayo, noma inabantu abaningi, ithatha isikhathi eside ukuma. Khulisa ibanga lakho lokulandela.
  • Ezimweni ezimbi (ngokwesibonelo ebusuku, uma lina noma kunenkungu), shiya ibanga lokulandela elilingana nemizuzwana engu-4.
  • Izimoto ezisindayo kufanele zishiye ibanga elilingana nemizuzwana engu-3 ezimweni ezijwayelekile, nelikhulu kunalokho ezimweni ezimbi.

nav.defensiveDriving.clearSpace.2.descri.text:
• Uma othile ekulandela eseduze kakhulu, khulisa ibanga lokulandela phakathi kwakho nemoto ephambi kwakho (ungazami ukwandisa isivinini).
  • Lokhu kukunika isikhala esengeziwe sokunyakazisa imoto, futhi kungase kumkhuthaze ukuba akudlule, okususa imoto yakhe endleleni yakho.

nav.defensiveDriving.clearSpace.3.descri.text:
• Uma uma ngemuva kwemoto emile (ngokwesibonelo lapho kunophawu lokuma) kufanele ukwazi ukubona amasondo ayo angemuva. Uma ungawaboni, useduze kakhulu.
  • Umhlahlandlela omuhle ukushiya ibanga elingu-4-5m ngemuva kwayo.
  • Kufanele ukwazi ukuphuma ngemuva kwayo ngaphandle kokuhlehla.
  • Uma useduze kakhulu, uma othile ekushayisa ngemuva ungase uphusheke ushayise imoto ephambi kwakho.
  • Uma useduze kakhulu, imoto ephambi kwakho ingase ihlehle ikushayise lapho iqala ukuhamba.

nav.defensiveDriving.clearSpace.4.descri.text:
• Uma ucindezela amabhuleki, imoto ayimi ngokushesha.
  • Uma uhamba ngesivinini esikhulu futhi imoto yakho isinda kakhulu, kuthatha isikhathi eside ukuba ime.
  • Ngesivinini esingu-65km/h amathuba okushayisana aphindwe kabili kunangesivinini esingu-60km/h.
  • Ngesivinini esingu-60km/h uzodinga ibanga elingu-45m ukuze ume.
  • Uma ubuhamba ngesivinini esingu-65km/h, lapho usufike ebangeni elingu-45m ubuyobe usahamba ngesivinini esingu-32km/h.
  • Linganisa ibanga elingu-45m emgwaqweni ngokuhamba ngezinyawo. Cabanga ngokuthi uma ingane ibigijima ingena emgwaqweni phambi kwemoto yakho ngaphambi nje kwalelo phuzu, ubungeke ukwazi ukuma kusenesikhathi, ngisho noma ubuhamba ngesivinini esingu-60 km/h kuphela.
  • Ngesivinini esingu-100km/h ibanga lakho lokuma lingu-100m.
  • Ngesivinini esingu-120km/h ibanga lakho lokuma lingu-130m.

• Ngento ngayinye oyibonayo engadala ingozi, zibuze ukuthi yini embi kakhulu engase yenzeke.

nav.defensiveDriving.generalK53Procedure.text: Kunezinyathelo eziyi-10 ezakha zonke izinqubo ze-K53. Esimweni ngasinye ungase usebenzise zonke noma ezinye zalezi zinyathelo. Esigabeni somshayeli se-Learn2Drive, inqubo ngayinye ichazwe ngokuningiliziwe, kodwa lapha sikubhalele izinyathelo eziyinhloko, sazihlukanisa ngamaqembu amathathu amakhulu.

1. Bheka (ngaphambili nakuzo zonke izibuko, ukuze uhlole isimo sezimoto emgwaqweni)
2. Bheka indawo ongakwazi ukuyibona ezibukweni (ukuze uhlole isimo sezimoto emgwaqweni)
3. Nikeza isignali (khumbula ukuthi amasignali ahlanganisa izinkomba zokujika, amalambu amabhuleki, ihutha noma izimpawu zesandla)

4. Bheka izibuko (zonke izibuko, ukuze ubone ukuthi kuphephile yini ukwehlisa isivinini)
5. Bhuleka
6. Igiya (shintsha igiya uma kudingeka)

7. Bheka indawo ongakwazi ukuyibona ezibukweni (ohlangothini ojikela kulo, ukuze uqiniseke ukuthi kuphephile. Lokhu kuhlala kuyinto yokugcina oyenzayo ngaphambi kokushintsha indlela imoto ehamba ngayo.)
8. Qondisa imoto ngesiteringi
9. Nyusa isivinini
10. Vala isignali yokujika

Amaqembu amathathu ayinhloko ezenzo enqubweni evamile ye-K53 angafingqwa kahle ngokuthi:

nav.defensiveDriving.introToK53.0.descri.text:
• Ngeminyaka yawo-1980's uhulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika wacubungula iziphakamiso zohlelo olusha lokuhlola abashayeli ukuze bathole amalayisensi okushayela. Isiphakamiso ngasinye sanikezwa inombolo entsha, futhi ukuhlolwa okungunombolo 53 yikho okwagcina kwamukelwe.
  • Kufana nokuhlolwa kwase-UK kweminyaka yawo-1980's.
  • Izinhloso eziyinhloko zokuhlolwa kwe-K53 ukukhuthaza ukushayela ngokuzivikela: ukuzivikela ngaso sonke isikhathi ekulahlekelweni ukulawula imoto yakho nasezingozini zokushayisana ezingase zenzeke.

nav.defensiveDriving.introToK53.1.descri.text:
Ukuze ushayele ngokuzivikela kudingeka:
  • Wazi ukuthi zisetshenziswa kanjani izilawuli zemoto yakho.
  • Uhlale uqaphile ngokubhekisisa. Lokhu kusho ukubheka nxazonke zemoto yakho, kuhlanganise nasezibukweni nasezindaweni ongakwazi ukuzibona ngezibuko.
  • Ukwazi ukubona izinto nezimo eziyingozi.
  • Wazi ukuthi ubhekana kanjani nezinto nezimo eziyingozi.
  • Uzinike isikhathi esanele sokusabela ezingozini, ngokugcina ibanga elanele phakathi kwakho nemoto oyilandelayo nangokugcina indawo evulekile ephephile nxazonke zemoto yakho ngaso sonke isikhathi.
  • Wazi inqubo eyisisekelo ye-K53: izinyathelo ezingu-10 ezisetshenziswa ezinqubweni eziningi zokushayela (isibonelo, ukujika, ukudlula enye imoto, njll.).

nav.defensiveDriving.introToK53.question.text: Yikuphi kulokhu okulandelayo okuyiqiniso mayelana nokuhlolwa kwelayisensi ye-K53 eNingizimu Afrika?
(2) Bekulokhu kusetshenziswa e-SA kusukela ngeminyaka yawo-1980's.
(3) Inhloso enkulu yohlelo lwe-K53 ukukhuthaza ukusetshenziswa kwezindawo umshayeli angaziboni ezibukweni.
Yazi kahle ukusebenzisa zonke izilawuli zemoto yakho; qaphela izingozi; shiya isikhala esanele esizungeze imoto yakho ukuze ube nesikhathi sokubhekana nezingozi.
Zazi kahle zonke izimpawu zomgwaqo; gcina imoto yakho ilawulwa nguwe; gcina izinga lotshwala egazini lakho lingaphansi komkhawulo ovunyelwe.

Hlukanisa phakathi kwezingozi ezinyakazayo nezinganyakazi; gcina imoto yakho isesimweni esifanele ukuba semgwaqweni; yiba nomuntu okuqaphile lapho ushayela uma unelayisensi yokufundela ukushayela kuphela.
Izimiso eziyinhloko okufanele uzilandele lapho ushayela ngokuzivikela yilezi:

nav.defensiveDriving.observing.0.descrip.text:
• Ngokuvamile, hlala ubheke umgwaqo ongaphambili ngaso sonke isikhathi lapho ushayela. Uma ubheka kwenye indawo, ngokwesibonelo ukuze uhlole izibuko zakho, kwenze ngokushesha bese uphinda ubheke phambili.
  • Hlola zonke izibuko zakho ezintathu njalo ngemizuzwana engu-5-8. Esivivinyweni sakho uzophucwa amaphuzu uma ungakwenzi lokhu.
  • Hlola nezilinganisi zemoto yakho ngezikhathi ezithile: hlola isivinini sakho nokuthi akhona yini amalambu axwayisayo akhanyayo.
  • Hlola izindawo ongakwazi ukuzibona ngezibuko njalo lapho uya kolunye uhlangothi lomgwaqo, ngokwesibonelo lapho usuka eceleni komgwaqo, ushintsha imizila noma ujika.

nav.defensiveDriving.observing.1.descrip.text:
• Lezi yizindawo ezizungeze imoto yakho ongakwazi ukuzibona ngezibuko zokubuka emuva.
  • Ungase uhlole izibuko zakho, ungaboni zimoto bese ujika... bese ushayisa imoto ebisendaweni ongakwazi ukuyibona ngezibuko.
  • Ukuze uhlole indawo ongakwazi ukuyibona ngezibuko ngakwesokudla, phendulela ikhanda lakho kwesokudla bese ubheka ngaphezu kwehlombe lakho ngamafasitela omshayeli nawomgibeli ongemuva.
  • Ukuze uhlole indawo ongakwazi ukuyibona ngezibuko ngakwesokunxele, phendulela ikhanda lakho kwesokunxele bese ubheka ngaphezu kwehlombe lakho ngamafasitela omgibeli ongaphambili nawomgibeli ongemuva.
  • Ukuhlola indawo ongakwazi ukuyibona ngezibuko kufanele njalo kube yinto yokugcina oyenzayo ngaphambi kokujika noma ukushintsha imizila.
  • Hlola futhi indawo ongakwazi ukuyibona ngezibuko ngaphambi kokuvula izicabha zakho.

nav.defensiveDriving.observing.2.descrip.text:
• Hlala emotweni emile (esihlalweni somshayeli).
  • Cela othile ukuba ahambe eza ngasemotweni esuka ngemuva. Kufanele ahambe aqonde, eqhele ngo-2m ohlangothini lomshayeli lwemoto.
  • Mbuke esibukweni esisohlangothini lomshayeli.
  • Uma engasabonakali esibukweni, usendaweni ongakwazi ukuyibona ezibukweni. Mtshele ukuba ame.
  • Phendula ikhanda ubone ukuthi kufanele ubheke kude kangakanani ngemuva ukuze umbone.

• Hlala ngaphakathi komzila wakho. Ungashayeli phakathi kwemizila emibili (lapho imoto yakho isemizileni engaphezu kowodwa).
  • Shintsha umzila kuphela uma izimpawu ezipendwe emgwaqweni noma izimpawu zomgwaqo zikuvumela.
  • Khombisa kusenesikhathi uma uhlose ukushintsha umzila.
  • Shintsha umzila kuphela uma kuphephile.
  • Into yokugcina okufanele uyenze ngaphambi kokushintsha umzila ukuhlola izindawo ongakwazi ukuzibona ezibukweni.
  • Uma ushintsha imizila engaphezu kowodwa, hlola futhi izindawo ongakwazi ukuzibona ezibukweni emzileni ngamunye.
Usebenzise uphawu lwesandla.
Uhlole indawo engabonakali ezibukweni kabili, kanye ngaphambi kokungena emzileni ngamunye.
Uhlole indawo engabonakali ezibukweni ngakwesokudla okungenani imizuzwana emibili ngaphambi kokushintsha umzila okokuqala.
Uma uwela imizila engaphezu kowodwa uya kwesokudla, kufanele:
Ushayela amasondo akho angakwesobunxele esemzileni owodwa, kanti angakwesokudla esemzileni omunye.
Uwela imizila emibili kuthelawayeka.
Ushayela ngaphakathi komugqa ophuzi ongakwesobunxele bomgwaqo.
Ukushayela ugxamalaze imizila kusho ukuthi:
Khombisa ngenkinobho yenkomba ukuthi uhlose ukushintsha umzila.
Hlola ukuthi akhona yini amamaki asemgwaqweni noma izimpawu zomgwaqo ezikwenqabelayo ukushintsha umzila.
Hlola indawo engabonakali ezibukweni.
Into yokugcina okufanele uyenze ngaphambi kokushintsha umzila yile:
(1) no-(2) kuyiqiniso.
Ngu-(2) kuphela okuyiqiniso.
Konke okukhethwayo kuyiqiniso.
Yikuphi kokulandelayo okuyiqiniso?
(1) Emgwaqweni ohamba izimoto ziya ohlangothini olulodwa, amasondo akho angakwesokudla angagxamalaza phezu komugqa womzila.
(2) Kufanele ushintshe umzila kuphela uma kuphephile ukwenza kanjalo.
(3) Awuvunyelwe ukushintsha umzila kuthelawayeka.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.dividedRoads..text:
• Lena yimigwaqo ehlukaniswe yaba izingxenye ezingaphezu kweyodwa ngomugqa noma ngesithiyo.
  • Hlala ngakwesokunxele somgwaqo ohlukanisiwe (ngaphandle uma uhamba izimoto ohlangothini olulodwa kuphela).
  • Weqa isihlukanisi kuphela lapho kunesikhala noma ezimpambanweni zemigwaqo, noma lapho uphawu oludwetshwe emgwaqweni noma iphoyisa likuvumela khona.
Ungazange weqe noma yiziphi izithiyo noma imigqa engaphukile emgwaqweni ukuze ufike lapho.
Imoto esondela iqhamuka ngaphambili eseduze kakhulu izofika kuwe ngemizuzwana engu-2.
Uvunyelwe ukushayela ohlangothini lwesokudla lomgwaqo ohamba izimoto kuzo zombili izinhlangothi uma:
Umgwaqo ohamba izimoto ohlangothini olulodwa onemizila emibili.
Umgwaqo ohamba izimoto kuzo zombili izinhlangothi kodwa onomzila owodwa kuphela oya ohlangothini ngalunye.
Yimuphi kule migwaqo elandelayo ongewona umgwaqo ohlukanisiwe?
Kuphela uma amalambu akho ezimo eziphuthumayo ekhanyisiwe.
Uma uyaliwe yiphoyisa lomgwaqo ukuba wenze kanjalo.
Uvunyelwe nini ukushayela ohlangothini lwesokudla lomgwaqo womphakathi ohamba izimoto kuzo zombili izinhlangothi?
Uhlale ushayela ngakwesokudla, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi mingaki imizila ekhona.
Uwele noma yiziphi izihlukanisi zomgwaqo kuphela lapho kunendawo evulekile khona
Emgwaqweni ohamba izimoto ohlangothini olulodwa kufanele:

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.intersections.text: Izimpambanandlela

• Yima ngokuphelele ngaphambi komugqa wokuma emigwaqweni enezimpawu zokuma nasemarobhothini abomvu.
  • Imiyalelo yephoyisa lomgwaqo ihlale iza kuqala kunezimpawu zomgwaqo, amasignali (okuhlanganisa namarobhothi) nezimpawu ezipendwe emgwaqweni.
  • Ezimpambanweni lapho kumiswa khona kuzo zonke izinhlangothi ezingu-3 noma ezingu-4, izimoto kufanele zihambe ngokulandelana kokufika kwazo. Vumela noma ubani obevele esempambanweni ngesikhathi ufika ukuba ahambe ngaphambi kwakho.
  • Amarobhothi abomvu acwayizayo asebenza njengezimpawu zokuma ezimpambanweni lapho kumiswa khona kuzo zonke izinhlangothi ezine. Kufanele ume ngokuphelele (ungagcini nje ngokwehlisa isivinini). Ofike kuqala uhamba kuqala.
Imigwaqo enezimpawu zokuma namarobhothi
• Dedela abantu asebengaphakathi kwendilinga abeza ngakwesokudla sakho.
Izindilinga zomgwaqo
• Yima ukuze udedele abantu abasengxenyeni yendawo yokuwela yabahamba ngezinyawo engasohlangothini lwakho noma abasondela kuleyo ngxenye.
Izindawo zokuwela zabahamba ngezinyawo

• Khombisa cishe imizuzwana engu-5 ngaphambi kokufika lapho ufuna ukujika khona.
  • Hlala ngakwesokunxele ngangokunokwenzeka ngaphambi kokujika.
  • Uma usujikile, lungisa isivinini sakho ukuze uhambisane nokugeleza kwezimoto.
  • Cisha inkomba yakho ngemva kokujika.
Ukujikela kwesokunxele empambanweni

• Khombisa cishe imizuzwana engu-5 ngaphambi kokufika lapho ufuna ukujika khona.
  • Hlala ngakwesokudla ngangokunokwenzeka ngaphambi kokujika (ngaphandle kokweqa umugqa ohlukanisayo ungene ezimotweni eziqhamuka ngaphambili).
  • Dedela izimoto ezisondelayo.
  • Dlula umugqa ophakathi nomgwaqo ozongena kuwo ngaphambi kokujika (ngaphandle uma lowo mgwaqo uhamba izimoto eziya ohlangothini olulodwa kuphela).
  • Uma kukhona isiqhingi somgwaqo noma iphoyisa lomgwaqo empambanweni, dlula ngakwesokunxele saso noma salo.
  • Uma usujikile, lungisa isivinini sakho ukuze uhambisane nokugeleza kwezimoto.
  • Cisha inkomba yakho ngemva kokujika.
Ukujikela kwesokudla empambanweni

• Uma imoto yakho izovimba ukugeleza kwezimoto.
  • Ungaweli imigwaqo noma ujikele kuyo ngaphandle uma kunesikhala esanele esivulekile ngakolunye uhlangothi ukuze uwelele ngokuphelele ngaphandle kokubeka izimoto engozini noma ukuzivimba.
  • Ungaweli izimpambano ezimakwe ngebhokisi ngaphandle uma unesikhala esanele ngakolunye uhlangothi ukuze uphume ngokuphelele empambanweni ngaphambi kokuma.
Izikhathi lapho kungafanele ungene khona empambanweni
Zihambe ngokulandelana kokufika kwazo.
Zilandele amarobhothi kuqala kunemiyalelo yephoyisa lomgwaqo.
Zime ngokuphelele ngemuva komugqa wokuma.
Emarobhothini abomvu akhanya ngokungacwayizi, izimoto kufanele:

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.Intersections.text: (1) Ungama ngaphakathi kwezimpambano isikhathi esanele kuphela sokwehlisa abagibeli.
(2) Abahamba ngezinyawo asebeqalile ukuwela umgwaqo lapho kukhanya uphawu lomuntu olubomvu kufanele balinde emgqeni ophakathi nomgwaqo kuze kudlule zonke izimoto.
(3) Kufanele udedele izimoto eziqhamuka ngaphambili uma ujikela kwesokunxele.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.intersections.text: Amarobhothi abomvu acwayizayo nezimpambano ezinezimpawu zokuma kuzo zonke izindlela ezi-4 kuphathwa ngendlela efanayo.
Uhlale unelungelo lokuhamba kuqala empambanweni enezimpawu zokuma kuzo zonke izindlela ezi-3.
Amaphoyisa omgwaqo kufanele ame kwesokunxele sempambano enophawu lokuma lapho eqondisa ukuhamba kwezimoto.
Mayelana nezimpambano ezinezimpawu zokuma, yikuphi kokulandelayo okuyiqiniso:
Uqale ukujika ngaphambi kokuwela umugqa ophakathi komgwaqo ongena kuwo.
Ujikele emzileni ongakwesokudla womgwaqo ongena kuwo.
Uqale ukujika ngemva kokuwela umugqa ophakathi komgwaqo ongena kuwo.
Lapho ujikela kwesokudla ungena emgwaqweni ohamba izimoto kuzo zombili izinhlangothi, kufanele:
Akumele ume phezu kwendawo ephawulwe njengebhokisi.
Kufanele udedele izimoto ezivela kwesokudla.
Unelungelo lokuhamba kuqala.
Uma kukhona indawo ephawulwe njengebhokisi empambanweni yemigwaqo:
Uma imoto yakho izovimba ukuhamba kwezimoto.
Ngaphandle uma uyalelwe yiphoyisa lomgwaqo ukuba wenze kanjalo.
Ngaphandle uma kunerobhothi elikhanyisa ngokulokoza ukukhanya okuluhlaza.
Awuvunyelwe ukungena empambanweni yemigwaqo:
Uhlehle ngokushesha ubuyele emgqeni wokuma ongemuva kwakho.
Uchezukele eceleni komgwaqo ume.
Ulinde kuze kuphephe bese uqhubeka ngokushesha ngangokunokwenzeka.
Uma usuvele ungenile empambanweni yemigwaqo bese ukukhanya kwerobhothi kushintsha kuba owolintshi, kufanele:
Izimoto ezilula.
Abagibeli bamabhayisikili.
Abahamba ngezinyawo.
Yikuphi kulokhu okuthathu okunelungelo lokuhamba kuqala empambanweni yemigwaqo?
Kusebusuku futhi ungaphandle kwendawo yasemadolobheni.
Awuvunyelwe neze ukwenza lokhu.
Uyalelwa yiphoyisa lomgwaqo ukuba wenze kanjalo.
Ungadlula uqonde empambanweni enophawu lokuma ngaphandle kokuma uma:
Unelungelo lokuhamba kuqala.
Kufanele udedele izimoto eziqhamuka kwesokudla.
Kufanele udedele izimoto eziqhamuka kwesokunxele.
Ezindilingini zomgwaqo:
Uhlole ukuthi zikhona yini ezinye izimoto eziqhamuka kwesokudla bese ungena uma kuphephile.
Ulinde kuze kube yilapho imoto obungemuva kwayo isiphumile endilingeni ngaphambi kokuba ungene.
Ucwayizise amalambu akho angaphambili kafushane ukuze uxwayise umshayeli waleyo moto ukuthi usuzongena.
Uma ulinde ngemuva kwenye imoto ukuze ungene endilingeni yomgwaqo, lapho nje leyo moto ingena kufanele:
(1) no-(2) kuphela.
(2) no-(3) kuphela.
(1) no-(3) kuphela.
Yikuphi kokulandelayo ongavunyelwe ukukwenza?
(1) Ukudlula imoto elinde abahamba ngezinyawo endaweni yokuwela abahamba ngezinyawo.
(2) Ukujikela kwesobunxele empambanweni yomgwaqo.
(3) Ukujikela kwesokudla lapho ungena endilingeni yomgwaqo.
Kufanele ukhombise ngenkinobho yokujika ukuthi uhlose ukujika cishe imizuzwana engu-... ngaphambi kokuba ujike.
Ukucisha inkomba yokujika ngemva kokujikela kwesobunxele.
Ukucisha inkomba yokujika ngemva kokujikela kwesokudla.
Ukungakhombisi ukuthi uyajika lapho ujikela kwesobunxele.
Akukho emthethweni:
Usanda kujikela kwesobunxele.
Usanda kujikela kwesokudla.
Usanda kujikela kwesobunxele noma kwesokudla.
Kudingeka ulungise ijubane lakho ukuze ungene kahle ekuhambeni kwezimoto emgwaqweni osanda kujikela kuwo uma:
Kwesobunxele.
Kwesokudla.
Erobhothini elinomcibisholo oluhlaza okhanyayo ucime, okhomba kwesobunxele.
Lapho ujika, kufanele ubeke imoto yakho eduze ngangokuphephile nohlangothi lomgwaqo ozobe ujikela kulo. Lokhu kungakwenza ungene endleleni yezimoto eziqhamuka phambili lapho ujikela:

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.overtaking.0..text:
• Umthetho ojwayelekile womgwaqo uthi hlala kwesokunxele, udlule kwesokudla.
  • Uma udlula, gcina isikhala esivulekile sizungeze imoto yakho naleyo oyidlulayo (ungabuyeli phambi kwayo ususondele kakhulu kuyo).
  • Uma udlula into noma imoto emile (isibonelo, ibhasi), qaphela abantu abangase baqhamuke behamba phambi kwayo.
  • Khombisa ukuthi uhlose ukudlula.
  • Uma ulungiselela ukudlula, ungangeni engxenyeni engakwesokudla yomgwaqo ngendlela eyenza kungaphephi ezimotweni eziqhamuka ngaphambili.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.overtaking.1..text:
• Izimpawu ezinqabela ukudlula noma izimpawu ezipendwe emgwaqweni (imigqa eqhubekayo) zikwenqabela.
  • Usendaweni yokuwela yabahamba ngezinyawo.
  • Ngaphandle uma ungakwenza ngaphandle kokungena engxenyeni engakwesokudla yomgwaqo (ngamanye amazwi, uma umgwaqo ubanzi ngokwanele) noma uma umgwaqo uhamba izimoto eziya ohlangothini olulodwa kuphela, awuvunyelwe ukudlula uma:
    • Ungakwazi ukubona umgwaqo ongaphambili noma izimoto eziqhamuka ngaphambili.
    • Useduze nesiqongo sommango (usondela esiqongweni segquma).
    • Usejikeni noma ekhoneni lapho ungakwazi ukubona okungaphambili.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.overtaking.2..text:
• Awuvunyelwe nhlobo ukushayela ehlombe lomgwaqo, onqenqemeni lomgwaqo noma kwesokunxele somugqa wonqenqema ukuze udlule enye imoto.
  • Uma nje ungakwenzi lokhu, ungadlula ngakwesokunxele:
    • Uma umshayeli ophambi kwakho ejikela kwesokudla
    • Uma umgwaqo uhamba ohlangothini olulodwa futhi ubanzi ngokwanele ukuba kungene izimoto ezimbili (endaweni yasedolobheni)
    • Uma umzila okuwo ubanzi ngokwanele ukuba kungene izimoto ezimbili (endaweni yasedolobheni)
    • Uma kunemizila engaphezu kowodwa eya ohlangothini oya kulo
    • Uma iphoyisa lomgwaqo likuyalela ukuba wenze njalo.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.overtaking.3..text:
• Hlala kwesokunxele ngangokunokwenzeka uma kuphephile.
  • Gcina isivinini singashintshi. Ungakhuphuli isivinini.
  • Ungangena ehlombe lomgwaqo uma enye imoto ikudlula ngaphansi kwezimo ezithile (bheka ngezansi).

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.overtaking.4..text:
• Ihlombe lomgwaqo liyingxenye engale komugqa ophuzi ngakwesokunxele somgwaqo.
  • Ungashayela kulo kuphela uma:
    • Ungena ehlombe lomgwaqo ukuze uvumele omunye akudlule, futhi
    • Kunomzila owodwa kuphela oya ohlangothini ngalunye, futhi
    • Kuphephile ukwenza kanjalo, futhi
    • Ukwazi ukubona phambili okungenani ibanga elingu-150m, futhi
    • Kusemini (phakathi kokuphuma nokushona kwelanga).

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.overtaking.5..text:
• Uma usemzileni 'osheshayo' (umzila osemaphethelweni angakwesokudla oya ohlangothini oya kulo) emgwaqweni onguthelawayeka futhi ufuna ukudlula imoto ephambi kwakho, ungakhanyisa ucime amalambu akho angaphambili ukuze wazise umshayeli wayo.
  • Uma usemzileni osheshayo futhi omunye umshayeli ekhanyisa ecima amalambu ukuze abonise ukuthi ufuna ukukudlula, iya kwesokunxele ngokushesha lapho sekuphephile ukwenza kanjalo.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.overtaking.qu.text: Ukudlula yigama elisetshenziswa ukuchaza ukuhamba uzungeze noma udlule kuphi kulokhu okulandelayo:
Uma udlula, ugcina ubuyele emzileni oqale kuwo, kodwa uma ushintsha imizila, ugcina ukumzila ohlukile.
Uma ushintsha imizila, kufanele uhlole izindawo ongaziboni ngezibuko kabili, kodwa uma udlula, kudingeka uzihlole kanye kuphela.
Ungadlula izimoto ezimbili ngesikhathi esisodwa, kodwa ungashintsha umzila owodwa kuphela ngesikhathi.
Umehluko phakathi kokudlula nokushintsha imizila ukuthi:
Ukudlula ezinye izimoto ngakwesobunxele uma zijikela ngakwesokudla.
Ukudlula ezinye izimoto ngakwesobunxele uma zijikela ngakwesokudla, inqobo nje uma ungangeni ehlombe lomgwaqo
Awuvunyelwe neze ukungena ehlombe lomgwaqo (onqenqemeni lomgwaqo noma emgqeni ophuzi ongakwesobunxele).
Ungangena ehlombe lomgwaqo kuphela phakathi kokushona nokuphuma kwelanga, futhi kuphela uma ukwazi ukubona kahle phambili ibanga elingu-150m.
Ungangena ehlombe lomgwaqo kuphela uma othile ezokudlula futhi kunomzila owodwa kuphela oya ohlangothini ngalunye.
Ukucwayizisa amalambu akho angaphambili komunye umshayeli emgwaqweni onguthelawayeka uma ufuna ukumdlula.
Ukushaya ihutha komunye umshayeli emgwaqweni onguthelawayeka uma ufuna ukumdlula.
Ukushayela emzileni wezimoto ezisheshayo (ongakwesokudla kakhulu) emgwaqweni onguthelawayeka.
Ubhale phansi inombolo yokubhaliswa, uhlobo nemodeli yemoto yakhe.
Ubike isigameko esiteshini samaphoyisa esiseduze phakathi namahora angu-24.
Uma omunye umshayeli ecwayizisa amalambu akhe angaphambili kuwe emgwaqweni onguthelawayeka, kufanele:
Abantu abangase baqhamuke behamba ngemuva kwalo.
Intuthu ephuma epayipini lalo lokukhipha intuthu.
Lapho udlula ibhasi elimile, kufanele uqaphele:
Kufanele ukhombise indlela ozoya kuyo ngezinkomba lapho udlula enye imoto ngakwesokudla, ngale ndlela elandelayo:
(3) Lapho usubuyele ngokuphelele emzileni obusuke kuwo.
Lapho udlula enye imoto, kufanele kube nendawo eyanele evulekile ezungeze:
Kungumgwaqo ohlukanisiwe futhi kuzodingeka weqe umugqa ongaphukile.
Kuzodingeka udlulele ohlangothini lwesokudla lomgwaqo ukuze uyidlule.
Uyidlule ngegiya lesithathu ukuze ube namandla engeziwe uma uwadinga.
Ukhuphule isivinini sifike ku-140km/h kodwa singeqi lapho, ukuze uqede ukudlula ngokushesha ngangokunokwenzeka.
Uma ungakwazi ukubona kahle umgwaqo ongaphambili lapho udlula enye imoto, kufanele:
Uma umshayeli ophambi kwakho ejikela ngakwesokudla, ungamdlula usebenzisa ihlombe lomgwaqo elingakwesobunxele.
Ungakwenza lokho emgwaqweni ohamba izimoto ziye ohlangothini olulodwa onemizila emibili.
Ukudlula ngakwesobunxele lapho kunomzila owodwa kuphela kodwa umgwaqo ubanzi ngokwanele ukuba izimoto ezimbili zihambisane, ngaphandle kwendawo yasemadolobheni.
Ukudlula uma uyalelwe yiphoyisa lomgwaqo ukuba wenze njalo.
Ukukhombisa ngenkomba ukuthi uya ngakwesobunxele uma udlula ngakwesobunxele.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.parking.0.des.text:
• Ukupaka kuwukuma isikhathi eside kunaleso esidingekayo ukuze kwehliswe abagibeli noma izimpahla.
  • Noma nini lapho upaka, kufanele usebenzise ibhuleki lokupaka/ibhuleki lesandla.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.parking.1.des.text:
• Kunoma iyiphi indawo okungavunyelwe ukuma kuyo. Lezi zindawo ziphinde zabhalwa ngezansi ngombala obomvu. Awuvunyelwe ukupaka noma ukuma kulezi zindawo.
  • Umbhalo omnyama ukhombisa izinto eziphathelene nokupaka kuphela. Awuvunyelwe ukupaka kulezi zindawo, kodwa uvunyelwe ukuma kuzo.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.parking.10.de.text: • Imithetho engenhla ayisebenzi ezimotweni zezimo eziphuthumayo/zokwakha/zamaphoyisa ezisemsebenzini futhi ezikhanyisa izibani ezifanele ezizikhombayo.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.parking.2.hea.text: Lapho ukupaka noma ukuma kunqatshelwe khona yilokhu

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.parking.3.des.text:
• Emgwaqweni onguthelawayeka (ngaphandle kwasendaweni ebekelwe ukuma).
  • Endaweni lapho umgwaqo unqamula khona ujantshi ezingeni elifanayo noma kujantshi wesitimela.
  • Ngakwesokudla somgwaqo ubheke izimoto eziza ngakuwe (uvunyelwe ukuma ngakwesokudla emgwaqweni ohamba izimoto ohlangothini olulodwa kuphela).
  • Endleleni yabahamba ngezinyawo (ngisho nengxenye yemoto yakho ayivunyelwe ukuba kuyo).
  • Endaweni lapho ungadala khona ingozi noma isithiyo.
  • Esiqhingini somgwaqo.
  • Endaweni yezitolo noma emzileni obekelwe abahamba ngezinyawo kuphela.
  • Phezu kwesisetshenziswa esivula irobhothi lomgwaqo.
  • Emgwaqweni noma ebangeni elingaphakathi kuka-1m ukusuka onqenqemeni lomgwaqo ngaphandle kwendawo yasemadolobheni.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.parking.4.des.text:
• Uhlangothi olungaphandle lwesondo eliseduze kakhulu netshe lonqenqema lomgwaqo luqhele ngaphezu kuka-450mm kulelo tshe (ngaphandle uma usendaweni yokupaka emakiwe).
  • Ungase usithe uphawu lomgwaqo.
  • Ububanzi bomgwaqo bungaphansi kuka-5.5m (ngaphandle kwemigwaqo ehamba izimoto ohlangothini olulodwa kuphela).

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.parking.5.des.text:
• Nomsebenzi wokulungisa umgwaqo noma indawo embiwe noma esinye isithiyo, uma ezinye izimoto zingaba sengozini noma zivimbeleke.
  • Nendlela yokungena egcekeni noma isango.
  • Nenye imoto uma ububanzi bomgwaqo bungaphansi kuka-9m.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.parking.8.des.text:
• Emhubheni.
  • Ebhulohweni (phezu kwalo noma ngaphansi kwalo).
  • Endleleni edlula ngaphansi komgwaqo.
  • Emgwaqweni oncishiswe ububanzi bawo obujwayelekile nganoma yisiphi isizathu.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.parking.9.des.text: • Endaweni yokuwela abahamba ngezinyawo, ohlangothini osondela ngalo kuyo.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.parking.quest.text: Izimoto eziphuzi kuphela ezivunyelwe ukupaka lapha.
Ukumisa imoto uma ungenazo izimpahla noma abagibeli emotweni.
Ukumisa imoto isikhathi eside kunaleso esidingekayo ukuze wehlise izimpahla noma abagibeli.
Ukuphuma emotweni uyishiye ingenamuntu oyigadile futhi injini ingasebenzi.
Yiziphi kulezi zindawo okulandelayo lapho kungavunyelwe khona kokubili ukuma nokupaka?
(3) Phambi kwendlela yokungena yezimoto noma kwesango.
Ngaphakathi kwebanga elingu-6m ukusuka endaweni lapho umgwaqo uncishiswe khona.
Ngaphakathi kwebanga elingu-5.5m ukusuka empompini yamanzi yokucisha umlilo.
Ebanganeni elingu-9m ngemva kokudlula indawo yokuwela yabahamba ngezinyawo.
Ibeke unxantathu wesimo esiphuthumayo ku-45m ngemuva kwayo.
Uma imoto yokwakha ifuna ukupaka endaweni okungavunyelwe ukupaka kuyo, kufanele:
Maqondana nokulungiswa komgwaqo noma umgodi ombiwe, awuvunyelwe ukupaka:
Ingxenye engaphakathi yesondo eliseduze kakhulu nonqenqema lomgwaqo kufanele ibe sebangeni elingeqile ku-450mm ukusuka onqenqemeni lomgwaqo.
Ingxenye engaphandle yesondo eliseduze kakhulu nonqenqema lomgwaqo kufanele ibe sebangeni elingeqile ku-450mm ukusuka onqenqemeni lomgwaqo.
Uma upakile, ngokomthetho, amasondo akho kufanele abe:
Amasondo akho angakwesobunxele asebangeni elingeqile ku-450mm ukusuka onqenqemeni lomgwaqo.
Amasondo akho angakwesokudla asebangeni elingeqile ku-450mm ukusuka onqenqemeni lomgwaqo.
Ungapaka ebangeni elingu-550mm noma ngaphezulu ukusuka onqenqemeni lomgwaqo.
Uma upake esikhaleni sokupaka esimakwe ngemigqa endaweni yasemadolobheni, kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi:
Yiziphi kulezi zindawo ezilandelayo ovunyelwe ukupaka kuzo ebusuku?
(1) Ngaphezu kuka-12m ukusuka esibanini somgwaqo esiseduze kakhulu endaweni yasemadolobheni.
(3) Ngaphakathi kuka-9m ngaphambi kwendawo yokuwela yabahamba ngezinyawo ohlangothini oqhamuka kulo, inqobo nje uma amalambu akho amakhulu angaphambili ekhanyisiwe.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.question.0.te.text: Iyiphi into yokugcina okufanele uyenze ngaphambi kokushintsha umzila uya kwesobunxele?

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.question.1.op.text: Lapho uqhubeka uqonde empambanweni yomgwaqo futhi imoto eqhamuka ngaphambili ifuna ukujikela kwesokudla.
Lapho uhamba ngesivinini esingu-60km/h endaweni yasemadolobheni.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.signalling.0..text:
• Sebenzisa amalambu okukhombisa ngaphambi kokuba:
    • Ume (amalambu amabhuleki)
    • Wehlise isivinini kungazelelwe (amalambu amabhuleki)
    • Ujike (izinkomba)
    • Ushintshe umzila (izinkomba)
    • Uye kwesokunxele noma kwesokudla emgwaqweni (izinkomba).
  • Khombisa kusenesikhathi (cishe imizuzwana engu-5 ngaphambi kwesenzo uma usebenzisa izinkomba).
  • Khombisa isikhathi eside kunalesi emigwaqweni enguthelawayeka noma uma uhamba ngesivinini esikhulu.
  • Qiniseka ukuthi izimpawu zakho zokukhombisa zibonakala ngokucacile.
  • Qiniseka ukuthi amalambu akho okukhombisa acishiwe ngemva kokuqeda isenzo.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.signalling.1..text:
• Sebenzisa izimpawu zezandla uma amalambu akho okukhombisa engasebenzi.
  • Kusetshenziswa lezi zimpawu zezandla ezilandelayo:
    • Ukuma/ukwehlisa isivinini kungazelelwe: yelula ingalo yakho yesokudla iqonde isuka ehlombe, bese uyigobela phezulu endololwaneni, intende yesandla ibheke phambili.
    • Ukwehlisa isivinini: yelula ingalo yakho yesokudla iqonde isuka ehlombe, intende yesandla ibheke phambili, bese unyakazisa ingalo iye phezulu naphansi isuka ehlombe.
    • Ukujikela kwesokunxele: yelula ingalo yakho yesokudla iqonde isuka ehlombe, bese uyigobela phansi endololwaneni, bese uzungezisa isandla siphambane nendlela izinti zewashi ezihamba ngayo (abagibeli bamabhayisikili nabashayeli bogandaganda nezimoto ezidonswa yizilwane bangelula izingalo zabo zesokunxele ziqonde zisuka ehlombe).
    • Ukujikela kwesokudla: yelula ingalo yakho yesokudla iqonde isuka ehlombe, intende yesandla ibheke phambili.
    • Ukudlula (ukhombisa omunye umuntu ukuthi akudlule): yelula ingalo yakho yesokudla iqonde isuka ehlombe, intende yesandla ibheke phambili, bese unyakazisa ingalo iye emuva naphambili isuka ehlombe.
  • Khombisa kusenesikhathi (cishe imizuzwana engu-5 ngaphambi kokwenza isenzo osikhombisayo).
  • Qiniseka ukuthi izimpawu zakho zibonakala ngokucacile ngaphambili, emuva nasezinhlangothini.
  • Uma udonsa enye imoto, sebenzisa izimpawu zezandla ukukhombisa ukuthi uya ngakuphi, ngoba izinkomba zakho zisetshenziswa njengezimpawu zokuxwayisa ngesimo esiphuthumayo.
  • Uma amalambu akho okukhombisa engasebenzi, ungangeni emgwaqweni onguthelawayeka. Azivunyelwe izimpawu zezandla ngaphandle uma kunesimo esiphuthumayo.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.signalling.2..text: • Uma kudingeka ume esimweni esiphuthumayo, ungakhombisi. Gcina izandla zombili esiteringini.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.signalling.qu.text: Uphawu lwesandla lokuma (ingalo yesokudla igotshwe yabheka phezulu, intende ibheke phambili) kufanele lusetshenziswe lapho:
(1)Ubhuleka kuthelawayeka futhi amalambu akho amabhuleki engasebenzi.
Imizuzwana engu-5 ngaphambi kokusuka lapho upake khona.
Ngesikhathi esifanayo lapho amalambu akho amabhuleki ekhanya.
Kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi usebenzisa inkomba yokujika:
Lapho amalambu okuxwayisa ngesimo esiphuthumayo ekhanya.
Akukho simo lapho umshayeli wanoma iyiphi imoto evunyelwe ukunikeza uphawu lwesandla:
Ukwelula ingalo yakho yesokudla iqonde isuke ehlombe, intende yesandla ibheke phambili, kuwuphawu lokuthi:
Zombili izandla kufanele zigcinwe esiteringini lapho ...

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.speedLimits.0.text:
• Ezindaweni zasemadolobheni (amadolobhana namadolobha amakhulu), isivinini esiphezulu esivunyelwe ngokujwayelekile singu-60km/h.
  • Ezindaweni zasemakhaya nasemigwaqweni kazwelonke, isivinini esiphezulu esivunyelwe ngokujwayelekile singu-100km/h.
  • Emigwaqweni enguthelawayeka, isivinini esiphezulu esivunyelwe ngokujwayelekile singu-120km/h.
  • Uma kunezimpawu zomgwaqo ezibonisa izivinini eziphezulu ezihlukile kulezi, kufanele kulandelwe lezo zimpawu zomgwaqo.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.speedLimits.1.text:
• Amabhasi amancane athwala abagibeli abakhokhayo namabhasi abagibeli akufanele neze adlule ku-100km/h.
  • Izimoto ezinesisindo esiphelele esingaphezu kuka-9 000kg (amaloli amakhulu) akufanele neze zidlule ku-80km/h.
  • Ogandaganda emigwaqweni yomphakathi abavunyelwe ukudlula ku-35km/h.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.speedLimits.q.text: Uma zingekho izimpawu zomkhawulo wejubane, umkhawulo wejubane ojwayelekile ezindaweni zasemadolobheni (amadolobha amakhulu namancane) uthi:
Umkhawulo wejubane ophezulu ovunyelwe kogandaganda emigwaqweni yomphakathi ngu-80km/h.
Amatekisi amancane athwala abagibeli abakhokhayo awavunyelwe neze ukuhamba ngejubane elingaphezu kuka-100km/h.
Uma uphawu lomgwaqo lubonisa umkhawulo wejubane ohlukile ku-60km/h endaweni yasemadolobheni, lowo mkhawulo kufanele ulandelwe.
Umkhawulo wejubane ojwayelekile emigwaqweni enguthelawayeka ngu-120km/h kulezi zimoto ezilandelayo:
Umkhawulo wejubane ojwayelekile emigwaqweni kazwelonke ngu-100km/h kulezi zimoto ezilandelayo:
Uma ungazi ukuthi siyini isivinini esinqunyiwe emgwaqweni kazwelonke, kufanele:

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.stopping.0.de.text:
• Ukuze uthobele:
    • Iphoyisa lomgwaqo
    • Ilungu labaqaphi bokuwelisa izingane zesikole
    • Umuntu oqhuba/ogibele/ohola izilwane
    • Uphawu olupendwe emgwaqweni
    • Uphawu lomgwaqo.
  • Uma ubandakanyeka engozini.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.stopping.1.he.text: Awuvunyelwe ukuma: Lapho ukuma kwenqatshelwe yilokhu

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.stopping.2.de.text:
• Emgwaqweni onguthelawayeka (ngaphandle kwendawo ebekelwe ukuma).
  • Endaweni lapho umgwaqo unqamula khona ujantshi noma kujantshi.
  • Ngakwesokudla somgwaqo ubheke izimoto eziqhamukayo (ungama ngakwesokudla komgwaqo ohamba izimoto ohlangothini olulodwa kuphela).
  • Endleleni yabahamba ngezinyawo (ngisho nengxenye yemoto yakho ayivunyelwe ukuba kuyo).
  • Endaweni lapho ungadala khona ingozi noma isithiyo.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.stopping.3.de.text:
• Indawo okulungiswa kuyo umgwaqo, indawo embiwe noma esinye isithiyo, uma lokho kungafaka ezinye izimoto engozini noma kuzivimbe.
  • Indlela yokungena ngemoto noma isango.
  • Enye imoto uma ububanzi bomgwaqo bungaphansi kuka-9m.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.stopping.3.he.text: Awuvunyelwe ukuma: Eduze noma maqondana nalokhu

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.stopping.4.de.text:
• Umhubhe.
  • Ibhuloho (phezu kwalo noma ngaphansi kwalo).
  • Indlela edlula ngaphansi komgwaqo noma ujantshi.
  • Umgwaqo oncishisiwe ebubanzini bawo obujwayelekile nganoma yisiphi isizathu.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.stopping.4.he.text: Awuvunyelwe ukuma: Eb ang eni elingaphansi kuka-6m ukusuka kulokhu

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.stopping.5.de.text: • Indawo yokuwela yabahamba ngezinyawo, ohlangothini osuka kulo uma usondela kuyo.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.stopping.5.he.text: Awuvunyelwe ukuma: Ebangeni elingaphansi kuka-9m ukusuka kulokhu

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.stopping.6.de.text:
Imithetho engenhla ayisebenzi:
  • Uma kudingeka ume ukuze ugweme ingozi noma ngenxa yezimo ongakwazi ukuzilawula.
  • Ezimotweni zezimo eziphuthumayo/zokwakha/zamaphoyisa ezisemsebenzini futhi ezikhanyisa izibani ezifanele ezizikhombayo.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.stopping.ques.text: Ebangeni elingaphansi kuka-5m ukusuka emhubheni ongaphansi komgwaqo
Maqondana nenye imoto lapho umgwaqo unobubanzi obungu-11m
Usendaweni lapho ukuma kungavinjelwe khona uphawu lomgwaqo, isignali noma umaka womgwaqo.
Usendaweni egcinelwe ujantshi lapho ujantshi unqamula khona umgwaqo ezingeni elifanayo.
Laba bantu abalandelayo bangakuyala ukuba ume:
(2) Ilungu lethimba lesikole eliqondisa abafundi lapho bewela umgwaqo.
Ume ngokushesha, kodwa kuphela uma usemgwaqweni onguthelawayeka.
Uvunyelwe ukuma kuzo zonke lezi zindawo.
Awuvunyelwe ukuma kunoma iyiphi yalezi zindawo.
Yiziphi kulezi zindawo ezilandelayo ongavunyelwe ukuma kuzo?
(1) Ebangeni elingaphansi kuka-1.5m ukusuka ephoyintini lamanzi lokucisha umlilo.
Yiziphi kulezi zindawo ezilandelayo ongavunyelwe ukuma kuzo?
Uyisisebenzi sezinsizakalo zezimo eziphuthumayo futhi uma ngesikhathi wenza umsebenzi wakho.
Uvunyelwe ukuma endaweni lapho ukuma kungavunyelwe khona uma:
Maqondana nalapho kwenziwa khona imisebenzi yomgwaqo noma kumbiwa khona uma ingxenye yomgwaqo okuhamba kuyo izimoto inobubanzi obungu-12m.
Ebangeni elingaphansi kuka-6m ukusuka emhubheni odlula ngaphansi komgwaqo.
Ebangeni elingaphansi kuka-5m ukusuka empambanweni yemigwaqo endaweni yasemadolobheni.
Kungumgwaqo ohamba izimoto eziya ohlangothini olulodwa kuphela.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.towing.0.desc.text:
• Ibanga phakathi kwezimoto ezimbili kufanele libe ngaphansi kuka-3.5m.
  • Kufanele zixhunywe ziqine.
  • Zombili izimoto kufanele zilawuleke.
  • Izithuthuthu, izimoto ezinamasondo amathathu, izimoto ezinamasondo amane zohlobo lwe-quad namabhayisikili anyathelwayo azivunyelwe ukudonsa izimoto.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.towing.1.desc.text:
• Uma intambo inde kuno-1.8m kufanele ifakwe ifulegi elibomvu.
  • Imoto edonswayo kufanele ibe nomshayeli onelayisensi yokushayela yalolo hlobo lwemoto ngaphakathi kuyo (umshayeli akadingeki uma kusetshenziswa insimbi eqinile yokudonsa noma amasondo angaphambili ephakanyisiwe engathinti phansi).
  • Akufanele kube nabagibeli emotweni edonswayo, ngaphandle uma kuyigandaganda edonsa inqola eyi-semi-trailer (futhi abagibeli bengakhokhiswa).
  • Awuvunyelwe ukweqa isivinini esingu-30km/h.
  • Ungasebenzisi intambo ukudonsa uma imoto edonswayo inamabhuleki angasebenzi kahle.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.towing.2.desc.text:
• Ungadlula isivinini esingu-30km/h uma kungekho bagibeli (izinqola ezingama-semi-trailer kuphela ezingadonswa ngesivinini esingaphezu kuka-30km/h zithwele abagibeli).
  • Imoto edonswayo ayidingi umshayeli.
  • Kufanele usebenzise insimbi eqinile yokudonsa uma udonsa izimoto ezinamabhuleki angasebenzi kahle.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.towing.questi.text: Uma udonsa enye imoto, ibanga phakathi kwalezi zimoto ezimbili kufanele libe:
Lezi zimoto ezilandelayo zivunyelwe ukudonsa ezinye izimoto:
Uyimaka ngefulegi elibomvu uma ubude bayo bungaphezu kuka-1.8m.
Uma udonsa imoto ngentambo, awuvunyelwe ukudlula ku-60km/h endaweni yasemadolobheni.
Uma udonsa i-semi-trailer enabagibeli abakhokhayo, uvunyelwe ukuhamba ngesivinini esingaphezu kuka-30km/h.
Uma udonsa imoto encane engenabagibeli ngensimbi yokudonsa eqinile, akufanele uhambe ngesivinini esingaphezu kuka-30km/h.
Le mikhawulo yesivinini elandelayo iyasebenza lapho udonsa enye imoto:
Umshayeli onelayisensi yesigaba esifanele semoto kufanele abe semotweni edonswayo uma:
Uma udonsa enye imoto ngentambo, awuvunyelwe ukuhamba ngesivinini esingaphezu kuka-... km/h:
Uma imoto yakho inamabhuleki angasebenzi kahle futhi udinga ukuyidonsa, kufanele usebenzise:

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.question.0.option.0.t.text: Ukugibelisa abantu abacela ukugitsheliswa emgwaqweni onguthelawayeka.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.question.0.option.1.t.text: Ukushaya ihutha ukuze ubonge uma othile ekuvumele ukuba ungene emzileni wakhe.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.question.0.option.2.t.text: Ukuya kancane ngakwesobunxele uma othile ekudlula ngakwesokudla ukuze akwazi ukubona kangcono.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.question.0.text.text: Isibonelo esihle sokushayela ngokucabangela abanye kungaba:

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.question.1.option.0.t.text: Awuvunyelwe ukuma ubheke izimoto eziqhamuka ngaphambili.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.question.1.option.1.t.text: Uma usembuthanweni womgwaqo, kufanele udedele abantu abangena embuthanweni ngaphambi kwakho.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.question.1.option.2.t.text: Isikhathi eside kunazo zonke imoto engapakwa ngaso endaweni eyodwa inganyakazi ngaphandle kwendawo yasemadolobheni singu-24 hours.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.theCar.emergencyTrian.text:
• Kufanele kube nonxantathu onemiphetho emibili, obomvu nomhlophe, obuyisa ukukhanya kuzo zonke lezi zimoto:
    • Amabhakkie
    • Ama-trailer
    • Amakharavani
    • Amaveni
    • Amaloli
    • Amabhasi amancane
    • Amabhasi
  • Wusebenzise lapho imoto yakho imile engxenyeni yomgwaqo okuhamba kuyo izimoto (ngaphandle uma isendaweni ebekelwe ukuma noma ime ngenxa yezinye izimoto futhi umshayeli esekhona kuyo).
  • Wubeke okungenani ebangeni elingu-45 m ukusuka emotweni yakho, ohlangothini izimoto ezizosondela ngalo, uhlangothi olubuyisa ukukhanya lubheke kuzo.
Onxantathu bokuxwayisa ngezimo eziphuthumayo kufanele baphathwe kulezi zimoto:
Lapho imoto yakho imile ngenxa yezimoto ezisemgwaqweni futhi umshayeli esengaphakathi emotweni.
Lapho umile endaweni emiselwe ukupaka ngaphandle kwendawo yasemadolobheni.
Okungenani ebangeni elingu-45m ukusuka emotweni yakho, ohlangothini okuzoqhamuka kulo izimoto.
Kufanele ubeke unxantathu oyisixwayiso sesimo esiphuthumayo:

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.theCar.lights.0.descr.text:
• Awuvunyelwe ukushayela emgwaqweni womphakathi (ngisho nasemini) uma noma yiliphi ilambu lemoto yakho lingasebenzi noma lingaboshiwe kahle.
  • Ngaphandle uma kushiwo okuhlukile, wonke amalambu kufanele abonakale ebangeni elingu-150m.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.theCar.lights.1.descr.text:
• Lawa kufanele akhanyiswe ngezikhathi ezilandelayo:
    • phakathi kokushona kwelanga nokuphuma kwelanga (kuhlanganise namalambu angemuva namalambu enombolo yemoto)
    • noma lapho kungabonakali kahle ebangeni elingu-150m ngaphambili (ngokwesibonelo emvuleni, enkungwini, othulini noma ekukhanyeni okufiphele).
  • Sebenzisa ukukhanya okufiphalisiwe ezindaweni zasemadolobheni noma lapho izimoto ziminyene khona.
  • Imisebe yamalambu akho afiphalisiwe ibheke phansi, futhi akufanele ifike emgwaqweni ebangeni elingaphezu kuka-45m ngaphambili.
  • Kufanele ikuvumele ukuba ubone imoto noma umuntu ebangeni elingu-45m ngaphambi kwakho.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.theCar.lights.2.descr.text:
• Qaphela ukuthi amalambu akho akhanya ngokugcwele angabaphuphuthekisa abanye abashayeli okwesikhashana.
  • Wasebenzise ngaphandle kwezindawo zasemadolobheni nalapho kungekho zimoto eziqhamukayo.
  • Cisha ukukhanya okugcwele lapho ushayela ngqo ngemuva kwenye imoto.
  • Kufanele akuvumele ukuba ubone imoto noma umuntu ebangeni elingu-100m ngaphambi kwakho.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.theCar.lights.3.descr.text:
• Uma imoto yakho inelambu elilodwa kuphela lokupaka, kufanele libe ngakwesokudla.
  • Amalambu okupaka kufanele asetshenziswe lapho upake:
    • ngaphandle kwendawo ephawulelwe ukupaka endaweni yasemadolobheni
    • ebangeni elingaphezu kuka-12m ukusuka elambini lomgwaqo emgwaqweni womphakathi.
  • Amalambu okupaka awavunyelwe ukusetshenziselwa ukushayela.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.theCar.lights.4.descr.text:
Lawa avunyelwe ukusetshenziswa kuphela ngabantu abalandelayo (lapho besemsebenzini):
  • Abasebenzi bezokwelapha
  • Amaphoyisa
  • Abasebenzi abalawula ukuhamba kwezimoto
  • Abacishi bomlilo
  • Odokotela noma odokotela bezilwane
  • Abasebenzisa amaloli okusiza izimoto eziphukile/izimoto zophiko lokuphakelwa kukagesi

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.theCar.lights.5.descr.text:
• Amalambu akho amabhuleki kufanele akhanye kakhulu kunamalambu akho angemuva.
  • Kufanele abonakale ekukhanyeni kwelanga okuvamile ebangeni elingu-30m.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.theCar.lights.6.descr.text:
• Ayikho imoto evunyelwe ukusetshenziswa emgwaqweni womphakathi uma ingenawo amalambu ezinkomba asebenzayo, abonakala ngaphambili nangemuva ezinhlangothini zombili.
  • Kufanele abonakale ekukhanyeni kwelanga okuvamile ebangeni elingu-30m.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.theCar.lights.7.descr.text:
• Amalambu akho okuxwayisa ngezimo eziphuthumayo empeleni angamalambu akho ezinkomba, wonke akhanyisa acime ngesikhathi esisodwa.
  • Uvunyelwe ukuwasebenzisa kuphela lapho:
    • Imoto yakho imile
    • Udonsa enye imoto noma imoto yakho idonswa
    • Kunesimo esiphuthumayo ngenkathi imoto yakho ihamba, ukuze uxwayise abanye abasebenzisi bomgwaqo.
  • Kufanele asebenze ukuze imoto ifanele ukuhamba emgwaqweni.
  • Qaphela ukuthi uma ekhanyisiwe awukwazi ukukhombisa ukuthi uzophendukela ngakuphi, ngakho sebenzisa izimpawu zesandla lapho uphenduka, ngokwesibonelo lapho imoto yakho idonswa.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.theCar.lights.8.descr.text: Zonke izimoto ezisemigwaqweni yomphakathi kufanele zibe nezibonakalisi ezimbili ezibomvu ngemuva.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.theCar.lights.9.descr.text:
• Zonke izinqola ezidonswa yizilwane kufanele zibe namalambu amhlophe ezinhlangothini zombili ngaphambili namalambu abomvu ezinhlangothini zombili ngemuva.
  • Uma umuntu ehola inqola edonswa yizilwane, kufanele ame ngasekhanda lesilwane sokuqala ephethe ilambu elimhlophe.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.theCar.lights.questio.text: Yiziphi izikhathi ongavunyelwe ngazo ukushayela emgwaqweni womphakathi uma izibani zemoto yakho zingasebenzi?
Izibani zangaphambili zemoto yakho kufanele zibonakale kumuntu obona kahle ebangeni elingu-... ukusuka kuzo.
Elinye lamalambu akho angaphambili okukhombisa ukujika lingasebenzi.
Elinye lamalambu akho angemuva okukhombisa ukujika lingasebenzi.
Noma yiliphi lamalambu akho okukhombisa ukujika lingasebenzi.
Awuvunyelwe ukusebenzisa imoto yakho emgwaqweni womphakathi uma:
Usebenzise izimpawu zezandla ukukhombisa ukuthi uyajika.
Amalambu okuxwayisa ngesimo esiphuthumayo angasetshenziswa kuphela ngabasebenzi bezimo eziphuthumayo.
Uma usebenzisa amalambu akho okuxwayisa ngesimo esiphuthumayo, kufanele:
Kukuziphi kulezi zimo ezilandelayo lapho ungasebenzisa khona amalambu akho okuxwayisa ngesimo esiphuthumayo?
Nezibonakalisi zokukhanya ezimbili ezimhlophe ngemuva kwemoto.
Namalambu okuxwayisa ngesimo esiphuthumayo abenyezela wonke ngesikhathi esisodwa.
Namalambu okukhanyisa indawo ethile angalungiswa lapho ebheke khona futhi asebenza kahle.
Ukuze zonke izimoto zikulungele ukuba semgwaqweni, kufanele zibe:
Namalambu amhlophe ngaphambili namalambu abomvu ngemuva.
Nomuntu ohola izilwane ephethe ilambu elibomvu ngasekhanda lesilwane sokuqala.
(1) Uma ungakwazi ukubona kahle umgwaqo ongaphambili ibanga okungenani elingu-150m.
Usebenzisa amalambu akhanyisa phansi ngaphandle kwezindawo zasemadolobheni.
Amalambu akho akhanyisa phansi ekhanyisa umgwaqo ebangeni elingaphezu kuka-45m ngaphambi kwemoto yakho.
Usebenzisa amalambu akhanyisa phezulu lapho ulandela enye imoto futhi kungekho zimoto eziqhamuka phambili.
Ebangeni elingu-100m usebenzisa amalambu akhanyisa phansi.
Ebangeni elingu-100m usebenzisa amalambu akhanyisa phezulu.
Ebangeni elingu-150m usebenzisa amalambu akhanyisa phezulu.
Kufanele ukwazi ukubona umuntu, imoto noma into enkulu emgwaqweni:
Ebangeni elingadluli ku-1m ukusuka onqenqemeni lomgwaqo.
Ebangeni elingaphezu kuka-12m ukusuka elambini lomgwaqo eliseduze kakhulu, ngaphandle kwendawo yokupaka ephawuliwe endaweni yasedolobheni.
Amalambu okupaka kufanele asetshenziswe uma upake:
Yikuphi kokulandelayo okufanele ukusebenzise ukuze ushayele uma amalambu akho angaphambili engasebenzi futhi kusebusuku?
Izimoto ezidonsa ngawo wonke amasondo amane.
Amalambu akhanyisa indawo ethile futhi angalungiswa lapho eqondiswe khona angasetshenziswa yilaba bantu abalandelayo emgwaqweni womphakathi:
Uma uhamba emgwaqweni onguthelawayeka futhi amalambu akho amabhuleki engasebenzi, kufanele usebenzise amalambu axwayisa ngesimo esiphuthumayo.
Amalambu akho angemuva kufanele akhanye kakhulu kunamalambu akho amabhuleki.
Womabili amalambu akho amabhuleki kufanele asebenze ukuze usebenzise imoto yakho emgwaqweni womphakathi.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.theCar.numberOfPassen.text:
• Inani labantu abangathwalwa emotweni lincike esikhaleni sezihlalo.
  • Umuntu ngamunye kufanele abe nesikhala sokuhlala okungenani esingu-380mm.
  • Izingane ezingaphansi kweminyaka engu-3 azibalwa.
  • Izingane ezineminyaka engu-3-6 zingahlala emathangeni.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.theCar.otherEquipment.text:
• Isiteringi akufanele sibe nokudlala okweqile.
  • Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma amasondo eqondile, akufanele ukwazi ukujika isiteringi ngaphezu kwamadigri angu-45 ngaphambi kokuba siqale ukujikisa amasondo aye kwesokunxele noma kwesokudla.

• Awuvunyelwe ukusebenzisa imoto elula emgwaqweni womphakathi uma ingenalo ibhuleki lokusebenza (ibhuleki lonyawo) kanye nebhuleki lokupaka (ibhuleki lesandla).
  • Emotweni elula, amabhuleki okusebenza kufanele akwazi ukumisa imoto ebangeni elingeqi ku-14m uma ubuhamba ngesivinini esingu-35km/h.
  • Ibhuleki lokupaka kufanele likwazi ukugcina imoto yakho inganyakazi lapho injini ingaxhunyiwe ohlelweni lokudlulisa amandla emasondweni, emthambekeni ofinyelela ku-1:8.33.

• Awuvunyelwe ukusebenzisa imoto ebanga umsindo owedlulele (isibonelo, ngenxa yesithulisi somsindo esiphukile) ngaphandle uma lokhu kwenzeka ngengozi, kungokwesikhashana noma kungaphezu kwamandla akho.
  • Awuvunyelwe ukuba nezinsiza ezifakwe emotweni ezibanga umsindo owedlulele.

• Awuvunyelwe ukusebenzisa imoto emgwaqweni womphakathi uma ihutha lingasebenzi.
  • Kufanele lizwakale ebangeni okungenani elingu-90m.
  • Akufanele libe nomsindo oshintshashintshayo (umculo).
  • Ungalisebenzisa kuphela ukuvimbela ingozi.

Lezi zinhlobo zamadivayisi okuvimbela ukwebiwa azivunyelwe ngokomthetho:
  • Idivayisi yokuvimbela ukwebiwa ephazamisa ukusebenza kwamabhuleki.
  • Idivayisi yokuvimbela ukwebiwa ekuvumela ukuba unqamule isiteringi ohlelweni lokuqondisa imoto.

• Ingilazi yamafasitela namawindi angaphambili kufanele ihlanzeke futhi ingabi nemifantu ukuze ukwazi ukubona ngaphandle ngokucacile.
  • Noma yimaphi amafilimu noma izinto zokufiphaza ingilazi akufanele zibe namabhamuza noma ukudabuka.
  • Awuvunyelwe ukusebenzisa imoto yakho emgwaqweni womphakathi ngaphandle uma inesula-mafasitela okungenani esisodwa esisebenzayo (leso esiphambi komshayeli ngqo).

• Izimoto ezilula kufanele zibe nesibuko okungenani esisodwa sangaphakathi nesisodwa sangaphandle (ohlangothini lomshayeli).
  • Amabhasi amancane, amabhasi namaloli kufanele futhi abe nesibuko sangaphandle ohlangothini lomgibeli.

• Kufanele ube nesicabha okungenani esisodwa kwesokunxele nesisodwa kwesokudla, ezingavuleka futhi zivaleke ngaphakathi nangaphandle.
  • Awuvunyelwe ukushayela izicabha zivuliwe.
• Isivalo sethangi lakho likaphethiloli kufanele sivalwe lapho usebenzisa umgwaqo womphakathi.
• Isilinganisi sakho sejubane kufanele sisebenze kahle lapho usebenzisa umgwaqo womphakathi.
• Imoto yakho kufanele ikwazi ukuya phambili nokuhlehla lapho usebenzisa umgwaqo womphakathi.

• Awuvunyelwe ukushayela ngesithulisi somsindo esiphukile.
  • Awuvunyelwe ukusebenzisa imoto yakho emgwaqweni womphakathi uma intuthu ephuma epayipini lokukhipha intuthu ihlupha abanye noma ivimbela abanye abashayeli ukuba babone.
Yikuphi kokulandelayo okudingekayo ukuze imoto yakho ibe sesimweni esifanele ukuba semgwaqweni?

Isivalo sethangi likaphethiloli sivaliwe kodwa singakhiyiwe.
Uvunyelwe ukuyishayela ezindaweni zasemadolobheni, kodwa hhayi emigwaqweni enguthelawayeka.
Uvunyelwe ukuyishayela kuphela ukuze uyiyise endaweni yokulungisa izimoto.
Awuvunyelwe ukuyishayela kunoma yimuphi umgwaqo womphakathi.
(1) Ubonise ukuthi uhamba ngesivinini esingaphezu komkhawulo wejubane esimweni esiphuthumayo.
(2) Uqaphelise umshayeli onemoto ekhipha intuthu eningi ngokweqile.

Imoto yakho ikhipha intuthu eningi ngokweqile.
Ibhuleki lokusebenza lemoto elula laziwa nangokuthi:
Ibhuleki lokupaka lemoto elula laziwa nangokuthi:

Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umshayeli ubona kahle, amawindi angaphambili akufanele:
Isesuli sengilazi yangaphambili esiphambi komgibeli siyasebenza.
Isesuli sengilazi yangaphambili esiphambi komshayeli siyasebenza.
Imoto yakho ayikulungele ukuba semgwaqweni ngaphandle uma:
Isibuko sangaphandle sokubuka ngemuva esisohlangothini lomgibeli siyadingeka kulezi zimoto:

(1) Imoto elula kudingeka ibe neminyango evulekayo engu-4.
