nav.rulesOfTheRoad.theCar.question.0.tex.text: Ukuze zonke izimoto zikufanele ukuba semgwaqweni, kufanele zibe nalokhu:
(2) Ihutha elishintsha ithoni noma ukuphakama komsindo.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.theCar.question.1.tex.text: Isitifiketi semvume yemoto yakho (idiski yelayisensi) sisebenza isikhathi esingakanani:

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.theCar.seatBelts.0.de.text:
• Awuvunyelwe ukusebenzisa imoto emgwaqweni womphakathi ngaphandle uma wonke amabhande ezihlalo esebenza.
  • Ungasusa amabhande ezihlalo emotweni kuphela ukuze alungiswe noma afakwe amasha, futhi awuvunyelwe ukusebenzisa imoto emgwaqweni womphakathi kuze kuqedwe ukuwalungisa noma ukufaka amasha.
  • Wonke amabhande ezihlalo afakwe emotweni kufanele aboshwe (ngaphambili nangemuva).
  • Uma kukhona isihlalo esinebhande esitholakalayo, umgibeli kufanele ahlale kuso kunokuba ahlale esihlalweni esingenabhande.
  • Uma kukhona isihlalo sokuphepha sezingane, izingane kufanele zisisebenzise; uma singekho, kufanele zibophe ibhande lesihlalo uma likhona.
  • Uma isihlalo somgibeli sangaphambili singenabhande, noma ubani oneminyaka engu-14 noma ngaphansi (noma omfishane kuno-1.5m) kufanele ahlale ngemuva.
  • Akudingeki ubophe ibhande lesihlalo uma uhlehla ngemoto.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.theCar.seatBelts.ques.text: Ukususa unomphela amabhande okuphepha emotweni yakho.
Ukuvumela abagibeli ukuba bahlale ngemuva uma imoto ingenawo amabhande okuphepha afakwe ngemuva.
Ukusebenzisa into yokubopha ingane ngokuphephile esikhundleni sebhande lokuphepha lengane.
Uma singekho ibhande lokuphepha esihlalweni somgibeli sangaphambili, laba bantu abalandelayo kufanele bahlale ezihlalweni zangemuva:
Noma yimaphi amabhande okuphepha afakwe emotweni kufanele aboshwe:
(3) Phakathi kokushona kwelanga nokuphuma kwelanga kuphela.
Kukusiphi isimo lapho ungadingeki khona ukubopha ibhande lokuphepha uma lifakwe esihlalweni sakho?

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.theCar.transportingGo.text:
• Noma iyiphi impahla esemotweni kufanele iboshwe iqine.
  • Umthwalo awuvunyelwe ukuthinta umgwaqo noma kuphi (yiketanga lokukhipha ugesi omile kuphela elingathinta umgwaqo).
  • Umthwalo awuvunyelwe ukuvimba umshayeli ukuba abone noma kuphi, kuhlanganise nasezibukweni zokubuka ngemuva.
  • Ubukhulu bomthwalo abuvunyelwe ukweqa lokhu:
    • Ukuphakama: ingxenye yokuphakama kwemoto uma umthwalo uthwelwe ophahleni (uma uthwele amabhayisikili ophahleni, angaphakama ngaphezu kwalokho)
    • Ukuphakama: 4.3m ezimotweni ezithutha impahla
    • Ububanzi: 2.5m endaweni ebanzi kakhulu (2.6m emalolini amakhulu noma emabhasini)
    • Ubude: umthwalo awuvunyelwe ukuphuma ngaphezu kuka-1.8m ngemuva kwemoto no-300mm ngaphambili.

• Noma yimuphi umthwalo ophumela ngaphandle kwemoto ngaphezu kuka-150mm ezinhlangothini noma u-300mm ngemuva kufanele ube nezimpawu eziyisixwayiso.
  • Uma ububanzi bomthwalo bungaphansi kuka-600mm, kufanele uphawulwe ngalokhu:
    • Emini, ifulegi elilodwa elibomvu (eliyisikwele esinohlangothi ngalunye olungu-300mm)
    • Ebusuku, isibonakalisi esisodwa esibomvu esibuyisa ukukhanya
  • Uma ububanzi bomthwalo bungaphezu kuka-600mm, kufanele uphawulwe ngalokhu:
    • Emini, amafulegi abomvu (ayizikwele ezinohlangothi ngalunye olungu-300mm) ekhoneni ngalinye
    • Ebusuku, izibonakalisi ezibuyisa ukukhanya/amalambu amhlophe ekhoneni ngalinye ngaphambili
    • Ebusuku, izibonakalisi ezibuyisa ukukhanya/amalambu abomvu ekhoneni ngalinye ngemuva
    • Ebusuku, izibonakalisi ezibuyisa ukukhanya/amalambu aphuzi ohlangothini ngalunye.
Ungasebenzisa kuphela iveni, inqola edonswayo noma iloli.
Kufanele ubeke unxantathu oyisixwayiso sesimo esiphuthumayo.
Ifulegi eliyisixwayiso lokubonisa ukuthi uthutha impahla.
Okungenani ukwazi ukubona ngaphandle ngefasitela langaphandle elisohlangothini lomgibeli.
Ushayele ukhanyise amalambu akho ayisixwayiso sesimo esiphuthumayo.
Uma impahla ivimba ukubona kwakho, kufanele:
Impahla ethwelwe ophahleni lwemoto ivunyelwe ukuphakama ngaphezu kwengxenye yobude bemoto kuphela lapho:
Emotweni elula, ububanzi bempahla endaweni yayo ebanzi kakhulu abuvunyelwe ukudlula ...
(1) Ungaphumeli ngaphandle kwemoto ngaphezu kuka-300mm ngaphambili no-1.8m ngemuva.
(2) Ukuphakama kwawo kungabi ngaphezu kwengxenye yokuphakama kwemoto uma uthwelwe ophahleni.
(3) Ungaphumeli ngaphandle kwemoto ngaphezu kuka-2.5m ohlangothini ngalunye.
Kumele usebenzise izimpawu zokuxwayisa uma umthwalo uphumela ngaphandle kwemoto ngo-30mm ngemuva.
Kumele usebenzise izibonakalisi zokukhanya eziphuzi ekhoneni ngalinye ngemuva ebusuku.
Kufanele umake imithwalo ephumela ngaphandle kwemoto ngamafulegi abomvu ayisikwele, angu-300mm ohlangothini ngalunye, emini.
Mayelana nezimpawu zokuxwayisa lapho uthutha impahla:
Uma umthwalo uphumela ngaphandle kwemoto ngaphezu kuka-300mm ngemuva noma u-150mm ezinhlangothini futhi ububanzi bawo bungaphezu kuka-600mm, kumele uwumake ebusuku ngalokhu:
(1) Izibonakalisi zokukhanya ezimhlophe noma amalambu amhlophe ngaphambili.
(2) Izibonakalisi zokukhanya ezibomvu noma amalambu abomvu ngemuva.
(3) Izibonakalisi zokukhanya eziphuzi noma amalambu aphuzi ezinhlangothini.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.theCar.tyres.0.descri.text:
• Imisele yokunyathela yesondo kufanele ijule ngaphezu kuka-1mm kuyo yonke indawo.
  • Iphethini yokunyathela kufanele ibonakale kuyo yonke indawo yesondo.
  • Akufanele kube khona:
    • ukusikeka ezindongeni eziseceleni kwesondo okungaphezu kuka-10% wobubanzi besondo, noma okude kuno-25mm, kuye ngokuthi yikuphi okukhulu kulokhu okubili
    • izigaxa noma ukuqumbeka noma kuphi esondweni
    • izintambo zangaphakathi, indwangu eqinile noma amabhande ensimbi avele obala.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.theCar.tyres.question.text: Imisele yesondo lakho kufanele ijule ngaphezu kwalokhu:
Akufanele kube khona izigaxa noma ukuvuvukala esondweni lakho.
Uma kukhona izigaxa noma ukuvuvukala esondweni lakho, kufanele kube:
Akufanele kube khona ... okuvelayo ethayini lakho:
(1) Imoto yakho isesimweni esifanele ukuba semgwaqweni uma ubona iphethini yemisele okungenani emathayini akho amathathu.
(2) Ungashayela ngamathayi anezintambo zangaphakathi ezivelayo uma lokhu kwenzeka ethayini elilodwa kuphela futhi uphethe ithayi eliyisipele.
(3) Kudingeka wazi ukuthi ulishintsha kanjani ithayi ukuze uthole ilayisensi yakho yokushayela.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.theCar.unauthorisedUs.text:
• Ungashayeli, ungene, ugibele phezu kwemoto noma uphazamise izingxenye zayo ngaphandle kwemvume yomuntu oyiphethe ngokusemthethweni.
  • Ungashintshi inombolo ye-chassis noma yenjini yemoto ngaphandle kokubonisana nesiphathimandla sokubhalisa izimoto.
Yikuphi kokulandelayo ongavunyelwe ukukwenza ngaphandle kwemvume yomuntu ophethe imoto ngokusemthethweni?
Awuvunyelwe ukushintsha ... yemoto ngaphandle kokubonisana nesiphathimandla sokubhaliswa kwezimoto.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.theDriver.accidents.0.text:
• Yima ngokushesha
  • Thola ukuthi ukhona yini olimele. Ulimele kangakanani?
  • Thola ukuthi yimuphi umonakalo odalekile
  • Uma kungekho olimele, susa izimoto uma zivimbe indlela
  • Sebenzisa onxantathu bokuxwayisa uma kudingeka
  • Nikezanani ulwazi oluningi ngangokunokwenzeka:
    • Igama/ikheli/inombolo kamazisi yabo bonke abashayeli abathintekayo
    • Igama/ikheli/inombolo kamazisi yabanikazi bazo zonke izimoto ezithintekayo
    • Uhlobo/imodeli/umbala/inombolo yokubhaliswa yazo zonke izimoto ezithintekayo
    • Imininingwane yezinkampani zomshwalense zazo zonke izimoto ezithintekayo
    • Uma bekukhona ofakazi, thatha nemininingwane yabo
  • Yiya esiteshini samaphoyisa nelayisensi yakho kungakapheli amahora angu-24 uyobika ingozi (ngaphandle uma amaphoyisa ebekhona endaweni yengozi)
  • Ungaphuzi utshwala/ungasebenzisi izidakamizwa ngaphambi kokubika ingozi

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.theDriver.accidents.1.text:
• Shayela amaphoyisa ngokushesha
  • Shayela i-ambulensi uma kudingeka
  • Siza abantu abalimele
  • Ungazisusi izimoto ngaphandle uma iphoyisa lomgwaqo likuyala ukuba wenze njalo, noma uma zivimbe ngokuphelele ukuhamba kwezimoto, futhi uzisuse kuphela ngemva kokuphawula ngokucacile izindawo ebezikuzo emgwaqweni. Zisuse nje ngokwanele ukuze ezinye izimoto zikwazi ukudlula.
  • Izimoto azivunyelwe ukususwa endaweni yengozi ngaphandle kwemvume yomshayeli, yomnikazi noma yomuntu ogunyaziwe
Uma umuntu elimele noma eshonile endaweni yasedolobheni

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.theDriver.accidents.q.text: Ususe izimoto ngokushesha ngoba abanye abashayeli bazobe besondela ngesivinini esikhulu.
Ubeke unxantathu wokuxwayisa ngezimo eziphuthumayo ku-45m ukusuka emotweni yakho, ngasohlangothini okuqhamuka kulo izimoto.
Uthole ukuthi ukhona yini olimele.
Uma kwenzeka ingozi ngaphandle kwendawo yasemadolobheni, into yokuqala okufanele uyenze yile:
Ukuthi omunye umshayeli ubengaphansi kwethonya lezidakamizwa noma lotshwala yini.
Uhlobo, imodeli nenombolo yokubhaliswa kwenye imoto.
Kufanele kuvunyelwane ngokuthi ubani odale ingozi.
Lolu lwazi olulandelayo kufanele lunikezwe omunye nomunye endaweni yengozi:
Kungekho monakalo kunoma iyiphi yalezi zimoto ezimbili.
Kuphakathi kokuphuma nokushona kwelanga futhi kusendaweni eyingozi.
Uhlale uphoqelekile ukuba ume.
Ngemva kokubandakanyeka engozini, awuphoqelekile ukuba ume uma:
(1), (2) no-(3) kuyiqiniso.
(2) no-(3) kuphela okuyiqiniso.
(3) kuphela okuyiqiniso.
Yikuphi kokulandelayo okuyiqiniso?
(1) Umshayeli wemoto ngayinye kudingeka asize abagibeli bemoto yakhe.
(2) Ungazisusa izimoto ngokushesha uma kukhona olimele endaweni yasemadolobheni futhi sekubizwe i-ambulensi, inqobo nje uma kungekho oshonile.

(3) Uma kukhona oshonile endaweni yasemadolobheni, awuvunyelwe ukususa izimoto ngaphandle uma zivimbe ukuhamba kwezimoto ngokuphelele, futhi ungazisusa kuphela ngemva kokumaka ngokucacile izindawo ebezikuzo emgwaqweni.
Kufanele uthole ukuthi yimuphi umonakalo odalekile.
Kufanele kubizwe amaphoyisa ngokushesha.
Akufanele uphuze utshwala noma usebenzise izidakamizwa emahoreni angu-24 ngemva kwengozi.
Kuzo zonke izingozi:

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.theDriver.alcoholDrug.text: Utshwala nezidakamizwa

• Awuvunyelwe ukushayela noma ngisho nokuhlala esihlalweni somshayeli injini isebenza uma
    • Usebenzise izidakamizwa ezidakayo (ngisho nemithi ebhalwe udokotela)
    • Ungumshayeli ojwayelekile futhi izinga lotshwala egazini lakho lingaphezu kuka-0.05g ku-100ml wegazi (0.24mg ku-1000 ml womoya owuphefumulayo)
    • Ungumshayeli onguchwepheshe futhi izinga lotshwala egazini lakho lingaphezu kuka-0.02g ku-100ml wegazi (0.10mg ku-1000 ml womoya owuphefumulayo)
  • Uma isikhulu esiphoqelela umthetho sikucela, awuvunyelwe ukwenqaba ukunikeza isampula yegazi noma yomoya owuphefumulayo
  • Awuvunyelwe ukubhema kuze kube yilapho isampula isithathiwe
  • Ngesikhathi le CD inyatheliswa, kwakukhona isiphakamiso sokwethula imithetho emisha eyenza kungabi semthethweni ukuba abashayeli babe nanoma yiliphi izinga lotshwala emizimbeni yabo eminyakeni yokuqala emithathu ngemva kokuthola ilayisensi. Sicela uhlole ukuthi lo mthetho usuqalile yini ukusebenza ngesikhathi uthola ilayisensi yakho.
Umthetho uthi

Uma abantu ababili bephuze utshwala obulinganayo, amazinga otshwala egazini labo angahluka, ngakho akunakwenzeka ukusho ngokuqondile ukuthi bonke abantu bangaphuza kangakanani ukuze bahlale bengaphansi komkhawulo. Ezinye zezinto ezithinta izinga lotshwala egazini yilezi:
  • Ubulili: ngokuvamile, izinga lotshwala egazini labesilisa likhuphuka kancane kunelabesifazane
  • Isisindo: uma unesisindo esincane, izinga lotshwala egazini lakho likhuphuka ngokushesha
  • Isimo sempilo yakho jikelele: uma ugula, likhuphuka ngokushesha
  • Ukuthi ubuphuza ngokushesha kangakanani (ukuphuza kancane kungcono)
  • Okunye okudlile noma okuphuzile, noma ezinye izidakamizwa noma imithi oyisebenzisile
Izinto ezithinta izinga lotshwala egazini

• Njengoba kushiwo, akunakwenzeka ukusho ngokuqondile ukuthi zingaki iziphuzo ongaziphuza ngaphambi kokuba weqe umkhawulo, ngoba kuncike ezintweni eziningi kakhulu. Kungcono uphuze kancane futhi uqiniseke ukuthi ungaphansi komkhawulo. Kodwa ukuze uthole umqondo, kufanele uphuze ngaphansi kwalokhu:
    • Iziphuzo ezingu-1-2 kwabesifazane (ungaphuzi ngokushesha okudlula isiphuzo esingu-1 ngehora)
    • Iziphuzo ezingu-2-3 kwabesilisa (ungaphuzi ngokushesha okudlula isiphuzo esingu-1 ngehora)
  • Kuthatha isikhathi ukuba utshwala buhlakazeke egazini lakho, ngakho uma uphuze kakhulu ebusuku futhi wangashayeli, ungase ube usengaphezu komkhawulo uma uvuka ngakusasa ekuseni bese ushayela.
  • Ngemva kokuyeka ukuphuza, vumela okungenani ihora ngesiphuzo ngasinye osiphuzile ukuze sihlakazeke.
Imihlahlandlela ejwayelekile yokuhlala ngaphansi komkhawulo

• Ingilazi eyodwa yewayini letafula (125ml)
  • Ithini/ibhodlela elilodwa likabhiya (340ml)
  • Isilinganiso esisodwa sotshwala obuqinile (25ml)
'Isiphuzo' esisodwa yilesi
Kufanele uhlale uphethe incwadi kadokotela egunyaza lowo muthi noma nini lapho ushayela.
Awuvunyelwe nhlobo ukushayela.
Awuvunyelwe ukushayela ihora elilodwa ngemva kokusebenzisa izidakamizwa.
Uma usebenzise izidakamizwa ngokuyalelwa udokotela:
Kufanele uxhumane nommeli ukuze abe khona ngaphambi kokuba unikeze isampula.
Awuvunyelwe ukubhema kuze kube yilapho usunikeze isampula.
Ungenqaba ukunikeza isampula uma usuvele unikeze isampula emahoreni angu-24 adlule.
Uma iphoyisa lomgwaqo likucela ukuba unikeze isampula yegazi noma yomoya owuphefumulayo:
Isilinganiso esisodwa esincane sotshwala obunamandla sicishe silingane nobhiya ababili.
Amayunithi amabili otshwala aphuzwe phakathi namahora amabili angaphansi komkhawulo ovunyelwe kwabesilisa.
Inani lotshwala umuntu okufanele aliphuze ukuze athathwe njengodakiwe ngokomthetho liyahlukahluka kumuntu nomuntu.
Mayelana nezinga lotshwala egazini:
0.2g ku-100ml wegazi kubashayeli abangochwepheshe.
0.05g ku-100ml wegazi kubashayeli abajwayelekile.
0.24g ku-100ml wegazi kubashayeli abajwayelekile.
ENingizimu Afrika, umkhawulo osemthethweni wezinga lotshwala egazini uthi:
Konke kuyiqiniso.
Akukho okuyiqiniso.
Ngu-(3) kuphela okuyiqiniso.
Yikuphi kokulandelayo okuyiqiniso?
(1) Awuvunyelwe ukuhlala esihlalweni somshayeli wemoto enenjini esebenzayo uma izinga lotshwala egazini lakho lingaphezu komkhawulo osemthethweni.
(2) Owesifazane onesisindo esingaphansi kwesifanele kungenzeka adakwe ngokushesha kunowesilisa onesisindo esingaphezu kwesifanele.
(3) Kungenzeka ukuthi izinga lotshwala egazini lakho lisengaphezu komkhawulo osemthethweni ekuseni ngemva kokuphuza utshwala.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.theDriver.cellphones..text:
• Awuvunyelwe ukushayela ubambe umakhalekhukhwini ngesandla noma nganoma iyiphi enye ingxenye yomzimba wakho.
  • Sebenzisa ucingo lwemoto, amahedisethi noma ikhithi evumela ukukhuluma ngaphandle kokubamba ucingo.
  • Lo mthetho usebenza kunoma iyiphi imishini yokuxhumana, njengemisakazo ephathwa ngesandla.
  • Awusebenzi kubasebenzi bezimo eziphuthumayo abasemsebenzini.
Kuphela ngabasebenzi bezimo eziphuthumayo abangekho emsebenzini ngaleso sikhathi.
Kuphela uma kusetshenziswa ikhithi evumela ukukhuluma ngaphandle kokubamba ucingo.
Ngabashayeli abangakwazi ukusebenzisa omakhalekhukhwini ngenxa yemikhawulo yezomgwaqo.
Ngamaphoyisa omgwaqo lapho enza umsebenzi wawo.
Amadivayisi okuxhumana ngaphandle komakhalekhukhwini, njengemisakazo yokuxhumana ephathwa ngesandla, angasetshenziswa:

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.theDriver.driversDuti.text:
• Hlala uyilawula imoto yakho ngaso sonke isikhathi
  • Qiniseka ukuthi ubona kahle umgwaqo ongaphambili
  • Amafasitela angaphambili nangemuva kanye nezibuko zokubuka ngemuva kufanele kuhlanzeke futhi kungaqhekeki
  • Hlehla kuphela uma kuphephile, futhi uhlehle ibanga elifushane ngangokunokwenzeka
  • Akukho ngxenye yomzimba wakho evunyelwe ukuba ngaphandle kwemoto, ngaphandle kwalapho unikeza izimpawu ngesandla
  • Suka kuphela uma kuphephile futhi ungeke uphazamise ukuhamba kwezimoto
  • Gcina ibanga eliphephile phakathi kwakho nemoto oyilandelayo ukuze ukwazi ukuma ngesikhathi (imizuzwana engu-2 iyibanga elijwayelekile lokulandela)
  • Dedela ngokushesha izimoto zezimo eziphuthumayo ezikhalisa amasayirini
  • Awuvunyelwe ukushiya injini isebenza uma
    • Imoto ingekho ngaphansi kokulawula kwakho (ungaphandle kwemoto)
    • Isivalo sethangi likaphethiloli sisusiwe
    • Imoto ikhipha intuthu eningi ngokweqile
  • Uma ushiya imoto, kufanele ubambe ibhuleki lokupaka
  • Imiyalelo yephoyisa lomgwaqo ihlale iza kuqala kunanoma yimuphi umthetho womgwaqo noma uphawu lomgwaqo/uphawu olupendwe emgwaqweni
  • Hlala kwesobunxele emigwaqweni ehamba izimoto eziya nhlangothi zombili. Emgwaqweni oya ohlangothini olulodwa, ungahamba kwesokudla
  • Phatha ilayisensi yakho yokushayela ngaso sonke isikhathi
  • Njalo shayela ucabangela ukuphepha kwabo bonke abantu nempahla emgwaqweni naseduze kwawo.

• Ungavumeli abantu noma izilwane ukuba zikuvimbele ukubona noma zikhinyabeze ikhono lakho lokulawula imoto noma lokunikeza izimpawu ngokucacile
  • Ungavumeli muntu ukuba athathe ukulawula isiteringi noma izilawuli
  • Umgibeli akavunyelwe ukushayela/ukuqondisa imoto ngaphandle uma kusobala ukuthi umshayeli akasakwazi ukuyilawula
  • Akukho muntu (noma isilwane) ovunyelwe ukuba ophahleni/esitebhisini/ebhodini lokunyathela eliseceleni kwemoto lapho imoto ihamba
  • Abagibeli abavunyelwe ukuba nanoma iyiphi ingxenye yomzimba ngaphandle kwemoto
  • Qiniseka ukuthi abagibeli bayakwazi ukuvula nokuvala iminyango nokukhulula amabhande ezihlalo
  • Qiniseka ukuthi babopha amabhande ezihlalo
  • Ungabavumeli ukuba bangene noma baphume lapho imoto ihamba noma kungaphephile
  • Abagibeli bavunyelwe ukuba ngemuva elolini noma evenini kuphela uma izinhlangothi zinokuphakama okungenani okungu-
    • 450mm uma behlezi (350mm e-KZN)
    • 900mm uma bemile (1250mm e-KZN)
  • Lo mthetho ongenhla awusebenzi kubantu abathuthwa ngenhloso yomsebenzi
  • Ungalayishi abagibeli ngokweqile. Ngamunye kufanele abe nendawo yokuhlala enobubanzi obungu-380mm okungenani
Ukushiya imoto yakho ingagadiwe injini isebenza.
Ukushayela uhlehla ibanga elingaphezu kuka-120 meters.
Ungakwazi ukubona kahle umgwaqo ophambi kwakho.
Kungumgwaqo okuhanjwa kuwo ohlangothini olulodwa kuphela.
(1) Awuvunyelwe nhlobo ukukhipha noma iyiphi ingxenye yomzimba wakho ngaphandle kwemoto ngenkathi ushayela.
(2) Imiyalelo yephoyisa lomgwaqo ihlale iza kuqala kunezimpawu zomgwaqo, amasignali noma izimpawu ezipendwe emgwaqweni.
(3) Kufanele udedele izimoto zezimo eziphuthumayo ezikhalisa amasayirini uma ziqhamuka ngakwesokudla sakho.
Lapho upaka futhi ushiya imoto yakho, kufanele:
(1) Abaphonsi lutho ngaphandle kwemoto ngenkathi ihamba.
(2) Bafaka amabhande okuphepha uma bengaphansi kweminyaka engu-14 noma ubude babo bungaphansi kuka-1.5m.
Uma umshayeli ezizwa egula, umgibeli osesihlalweni sangaphambili kufanele athathe ukulawula isiteringi ngokushesha.
Abantu noma izilwane abavunyelwe ukuba sesitebhisini esiseceleni semoto ngenkathi ihamba.
Iloli elithutha abasebenzi basemapulazini kufanele libe nezinhlangothi ezinobude okungenani obungu-450mm uma behlezi.
Imoto yakho ilayishwe ngokweqile uma umgibeli ngamunye engenaso isikhala sokuhlala esingange-... okungenani.
Uqinisekise ukuthi ziboshiwe ukuze zingakwazi ukuhambahamba emotweni.
Ufake isicelo semvume efanele kuziphathimandla zendawo yangakini.
Uma uthutha izilwane ngaphakathi kwemoto encane kufanele:
Uxwayise abanye abashayeli usebenzisa amalambu akho okuxwayisa ngezimo eziphuthumayo.
Uma uzwa inhlabamkhosi yemoto yezimo eziphuthumayo kufanele:

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.theDriver.learnerDriv.text: Abashayeli abafundayo

Uma unelayisensi yokufundela ukushayela ungashayela imoto, kodwa kufanele ulandele le mithetho:
  • Kufanele uhlale uphethe ilayisensi yakho yokufundela ukushayela ngaso sonke isikhathi lapho ushayela
  • Kufanele uhlale unomuntu okuqondisayo ohamba nawe, futhi lowo muntu:
    • Kufanele abe nelayisensi esemthethweni yokushayela imoto yesigaba esifanayo
    • Kufanele ahlale esihlalweni somgibeli noma ngemuva kwesihlalo somshayeli uma engakwazi ukuhlala esihlalweni somgibeli
    • Akufanele abe ngaphansi kwethonya lezidakamizwa noma lotshwala
  • Umthetho awukuphoqi ukuba usebenzise izimpawu ezinohlamvu L, kodwa abanye abashayeli bangase bakubekezelele kakhudlwana uma uzisebenzisa (khumbula ukuzisusa njalo ngemva kokuzijwayeza ukushayela)
  • Ungaba nabanye abagibeli emotweni, kodwa akuvunyelwe ukuba kube ngabagibeli abakhokhelayo
  • Ungashayela emigwaqweni enguthelawayeka.
Ilayisensi Yokufundela Ukushayela ingivumela ukuba ngenzeni?
Izinyanga ezingu-18 kusukela ngosuku owaphasa ngalo isivivinyo sakho.
Ilayisensi Yokufundela Ukushayela isebenza isikhathi esingakanani?

• Ukuze ushayele izimoto ezincane kufanele ube neminyaka engu-17 noma ngaphezulu.
  • Akufanele kube khona inkantolo ekwenqabele ukuthola ilayisensi yokufunda ukushayela noma ilayisensi yokushayela.
  • Awuvunyelwe ukufaka isicelo uma ilayisensi yakho imisiwe futhi isikhathi sokumiswa singakapheli, noma uma ilayisensi yakho ifakwe isiqinisekiso somkhawulo noma ihoxisiwe.
  • Awuvunyelwe ukufaka isicelo uma usunayo ilayisensi yesigaba esifanayo semoto.
  • Akufanele ube nokukhubazeka ngokomzimba noma ngokwengqondo okungenza kube nzima noma kube yingozi ukuba ushayele (kuhlanganise nesifo sokuwa noma isifo sikashukela esingalawuleki). Uma usunayo ilayisensi bese uthola ukuthi unesimo esinjalo, kungumthwalo wakho ukubika lokho kuziphathimandla zingakapheli izinsuku ezingu-21 utholile ngaso.
Izimfuneko Zelayisensi Yokufundela Ukushayela

• Awuvunyelwe ukuba nelayisensi yokufunda ukushayela ngaphandle kokuba izinga lokubona kwakho ngokwesilinganiso se-Snellen libe ngu-
    • 6/12 (20/40) esweni ngalinye
    • noma uma izinga lokubona kwelinye iso lingaphansi kuka-6/12, elinye iso kufanele libe ngu-6/9 (20/30)
  • Ungahlolwa amehlo ugqoke izibuko noma amalensi athintana namehlo. Uma wenza kanjalo, ilayisensi yakho izofakwa isiqinisekiso salowo mkhawulo futhi kuyodingeka ugqoke izibuko noma amalensi athintana namehlo njalo lapho ushayela.
  • Uma ungaphumeleli ekuhlolweni kwamehlo emnyangweni wezomgwaqo, ungaya kudokotela wamehlo obhalisiwe ukuze uhlolwe futhi. Uma uphumelela ngokokuhlolwa kwakhe, umnyango wezomgwaqo kufanele wamukele lowo mphumela.
Ukubona

• Yiya mathupha esikhungweni sokuhlolwa kwelayisensi yokufunda ukushayela uyobhukha ukuhlolwa kwakho.
  • Phatha imali enqunyiwe. Iyahluka ngokwezifundazwe, ngakho xhumana nesikhungo sakho sokuhlolwa ukuze uthole ukuthi yimalini.
  • Phatha incwadi yakho kamazisi esemthethweni.
  • Phatha izithombe ezimbili zikamazisi (zingaba ngezombala noma ezimnyama nezimhlophe).
  • Esikhungweni sokuhlolwa uzogcwalisa iFomu LL1.
  • Amehlo akho azohlolwa esikhungweni sokuhlolwa.
  • Uzonikezwa usuku okufanele ubuye ngalo uzohlolwa.
Ukubhukhela ukuhlolwa kwelayisensi yokufunda ukushayela

• Ukuhlolwa kwakho kwelayisensi yokufunda ukushayela kuwukuhlolwa okubhaliwe kolwazi okuhlanganisa izigaba ezintathu eziyinhloko:
    • Imithetho yomgwaqo, izimpawu zokulawula izimoto kanye nemigomo yokushayela ngokugwema izingozi
    • Izimpawu zomgwaqo nezimpawu ezipendwe emgwaqweni
    • Izilawuli zemoto
  • Yonke imibuzo inezimpendulo ongakhetha kuzo.
  • Kufanele wenze kahle kuzo zontathu izigaba. Ngisho noma amamaki akho ewonke ephezulu, uma ungenzanga kahle kwesinye sezigaba ungafeyila.
  • Uzonikezwa incwajana yemibuzo yokuhlolwa nencwajana yemidwebo enezithombe, ngokwesibonelo izimpawu zomgwaqo nezimo ezenzeka emgwaqweni. Eminye imibuzo yokuhlolwa ibhekisela ezithombeni ezisencwajaneni yemidwebo.
Uhlolwa kanjani?
Ukuthwala abagibeli emotweni yakho.
Ukushayela ngesivinini esingaphezu kuka-100km/h.
Ukushayela ungayiphethe ilayisensi yakho.
Uma unelayisensi yokufunda ukushayela kuphela, awuvunyelwe:
Ushayele kuphela uma unomuntu okuqaphile onelayisensi yesigaba semoto oyishayelayo.
Ungashayeli emigwaqweni enguthelawayeka.
Ufake isicelo selayisensi yakho yokushayela zingakapheli izinyanga eziyi-12.
Uma usunelayisensi yokufundela ukushayela kufanele:
Uneminyaka engaphezu kwe-17
Usunelayisensi yesigaba esifanayo semoto.
Ugqoka izibuko.
Awuvunyelwe ukuthola ilayisensi yokufundela ukushayela uma:
Asikho kuzo esiyiqiniso.
Ngu-(2) no-(3) kuphela abayiqiniso.
Ngu-(3) kuphela oyiqiniso.
Yiziphi kulezi zitatimende ezilandelayo eziyiqiniso?
(1) Uma ugqoka izibuko ngeke kudingeke uhlolelwe amehlo lapho ufaka isicelo selayisensi yokufundela ukushayela.
(2) Uma inkantolo ikuvimbele ukuba nelayisensi yokushayela kufanele uphinde ufake isicelo selayisensi yokufundela ukushayela futhi uphinde ubhale ukuhlolwa.
(3) Uvunyelwe ukudonsa ikharavani noma inqola edonswayo uma unelayisensi yokufundela ukushayela kuphela.
Ngu-(1) kuphela oyimpendulo efanele
Ngu-(1) no-(2) kuphela abayizimpendulo ezifanele
U-(1), u-(2) no-(3) bonke bafanele
Uvunyelwe ukuthola ilayisensi yokufundela ukushayela kuphela uma:
(1) Ilayisensi yakho ingakamiswa, noma isikhathi sokumiswa kwayo sesiphelile.
(2) Ungenayo kakade ilayisensi yesigaba esifanayo semoto.
(3) Ungenakho ukukhubazeka komzimba noma kwengqondo okungenza kungaphephi ukuba ushayele.
Izimpawu zomgwaqo, Amasignali omgwaqo, Izimpawu ezipendwe emgwaqweni.
Imithetho yomgwaqo, Izimpawu zomgwaqo/izimpawu ezipendwe emgwaqweni, Izilawuli zemoto.
Ukushayela ngokuzivikela, Izinqubo ze-K53, Izimpawu/amasignali omgwaqo.
Ukuhlolwa kwelayisensi yokufunda ukushayela kunezigaba ezintathu ezilandelayo:
(1) no-(2) kuphela okuyiqiniso.
(2) no-(3) kuphela okuyiqiniso.
(1) no-(3) kuphela okuyiqiniso.
Yiziphi kulezi zitatimende ezilandelayo eziyiqiniso?
(1) Ukuhlolwa kwelayisensi yokufunda ukushayela kunemibuzo yokukhetha impendulo kuphela.
(2) Eminye imibuzo ekuhlolweni ibhekisela emidwebeni nasezithombeni ezisencwajaneni yemidwebo.
(3) Ukuhlolwa kwelayisensi yokufunda ukushayela kunengxenye ebhalwayo nengxenye yokushayela ngokoqobo.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.theRoad.damageToPubli.text:
• Awuvunyelwe ukuvimba noma ukuphazamisa ukuhamba kwezimoto emgwaqweni womphakathi.
  • Awuvunyelwe ukubeka noma yini emgwaqweni engabangela lokho.

Kufanele uthole imvume ebhaliwe kuziphathimandla zesifundazwe ngaphambi kokuhlela noma ukubamba iqhaza kunoma yimuphi wale misebenzi emgwaqweni womphakathi:
  • Umjaho
  • Ukuhlolwa kwejubane/ukwethembeka kwemoto
  • Umhlangano wezemidlalo
  • Noma yimuphi umsebenzi ongaphazamisa noma ubeke engozini ukuhamba kwezimoto okuvamile

• Awuvunyelwe ukuhudula amasondo akho noma ukuwaphendula eshelela endaweni eyodwa.
  • Awuvunyelwe ukufaka izivimbamasondo noma izicathulo zokuvimba amasondo phakathi kwamasondo akho nomgwaqo.
  • Awuvunyelwe ukulimaza ubuso bomgwaqo nganoma iyiphi indlela.
  • Awuvunyelwe ukuhambisa imoto endleleni yabahamba ngezinyawo (ngisho nangokuyiphusha noma ukuyidonsa).
  • Ungabeki uphethiloli, uwoyela noma noma yini engcolisayo noma engamukelekile emgwaqweni, eceleni komgwaqo noma emanzini agelezayo.
  • Ungahuduli noma yini ebusweni bomgwaqo engawulimaza noma ibangele ingozi noma umonakalo kubasebenzisi bomgwaqo.

• Awuvunyelwe ukusebenzisa noma ukufaka isibani noma into yokukhanyisa ebonakala emgwaqweni womphakathi ngendlela ebeka ukuphepha engozini.
  • Lo mthetho ubhekisela ezibanini ezifakwe eceleni kwemigwaqo, hhayi ezibanini zezimoto.
Ukulandela ezinye izimoto usondele kakhulu kuzo.
Ukuphazamisa ukuhamba kwezimoto akuvunyelwe. Ukuphazamisa ukuhamba kwezimoto kusho:
Ukubeka amakhoni omgwaqo ukuze uvimbele izimoto ukuba zingangeni engxenyeni yomgwaqo kuvunyelwe kuphela uma:
Yikuphi kokulandelayo okudinga imvume esemthethweni ukuze ukuhlele emgwaqweni womphakathi?
Ungakwenza kuphela phambi kwesakhiwo okungesakho noma osiqashile.
Ungayisa imoto endaweni yokuhamba ngezinyawo kuphela isikhathi esidingekayo ukuze wehlise izimpahla kanye/noma abagibeli.
Awuvunyelwe nhlobo ukuhambisa imoto endaweni yokuhamba ngezinyawo.
Mayelana nokupaka imoto yakho endaweni yokuhamba ngezinyawo:
Ukuhudula amasondo akho noma ukuwaphendulisa endaweni eyodwa.
Ukudonsa inqola edonswayo enesisindo esingaphezu kuka-3 500kg.
Ukulimaza imigwaqo yomphakathi akuvunyelwe. Lokhu kuhlanganisa:
(1) Ukudlala umculo ophezulu uma indlu yakho isebangeni elingeqi ku-10m ukusuka emgwaqweni omkhulu lapho umsindo ungaphazamisa khona abashayeli.
(2) Ukufaka isibani esikhanya kakhulu ngaphandle kwendlu yakho esingaphazamisa abashayeli.
(3) Ukuchithela amafutha asesetshenzisiwe enjini yemoto yakho emgwaqweni womphakathi.
Izivimbeli zamasondo noma izicathulo zamasondo akuvunyelwe ukusetshenziswa ngoba:
Kukuyiphi indawo lapho ukuchithela uphethiloli kuyicala lomgwaqo?

  • Ogandaganda (ngaphandle kwalabo abasetshenziselwa ukwakha/ukunakekela imigwaqo)
  • Amabhayisikili anyathelwayo (anamasondo amabili, amathathu noma amane)
  • Izithuthuthu ezisebenza ngogesi
  • Izithuthuthu ezinomthamo wenjini ongaphansi kuka-50cc
  • Izimoto ezinamasondo amathathu/amane
  • Izimoto ezinesisindo esingaphansi kuka-230 kg (ikakhulukazi izimoto zabantu abakhubazekile)

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.theRoad.freeways.1.de.text:
• Ukusebenzisa izimpawu zesandla (ngaphandle kwezimo eziphuthumayo)
  • Ukuhlehla ngemoto
  • Ukushayela unqamule izihlukanisi zomgwaqo noma iziqhingi zomgwaqo
  • Ukushiya izilwane noma ukuzivumela ukuba zingene emgwaqweni onguthelawayeka
  • Awuvunyelwe ukuba ngezinyawo (uhambe), noma umise imoto yakho, ngaphandle uma:
    • Ulandela uphawu lomgwaqo noma umyalelo wephoyisa lomgwaqo
    • Usendaweni ephawulelwe ukumisa/ukupaka
    • Kunesizathu esingaphezu kwamandla akho
    • Uyilungu loMbutho Wezakhamuzi futhi usohlangothini lwesobunxele lomgwaqo onguthelawayeka, phakathi komgwaqo ophumayo nomgwaqo ongenayo
    • Ulanda noma wehlisa ilungu loMbutho Wezakhamuzi endaweni echazwe ngenhla
    • Abasebenzi bezimo eziphuthumayo nabasebenzi bokunakekela imigwaqo abasemsebenzini bangamisa izimoto futhi bahambe ngezinyawo emigwaqweni enguthelawayeka

Yikuphi kokulandelayo okuvunyelwe ukuhamba emigwaqweni engothelawayeka?
Uma nje uqhele okungenani ngo-1m emgqeni wonqenqema lomgwaqo.
Kuphela uma uzogibelisa ilungu loMbutho Wezakhamuzi.
Yikuphi kokulandelayo okuvunyelwe ukuhamba emigwaqweni enguthelawayeka?
(1) Izithuthuthu ezinomthamo wenjini ophakathi kuka-25cc no-50cc.
(2) Izithuthuthu ezinomthamo wenjini ophakathi kuka-50cc no-75cc.
(3) Izithuthuthu ezinomthamo wenjini ophakathi kuka-75cc no-100cc.
Uma umshayeli elawula izilwane ngezintambo zokuzilawula.
Izimoto ezidonswa yizilwane zivunyelwe ukuhamba emigwaqweni enguthelawayeka:
Ogandaganda abasebenza ekunakekeleni noma ekwakheni imigwaqo.
Ngaphansi kwezimo ezijwayelekile emgwaqweni onguthelawayeka, awuvunyelwe:
Abasebenzi basemapulazini, noma abantu abaya emsebenzini.
Laba bantu abalandelayo bavunyelwe ukuhamba ngezinyawo emgwaqweni onguthelawayeka:
Kwenzeke ingozi ngakolunye uhlangothi futhi kudingeka uyosiza.
Udlule indawo obekufanele uphume kuyo futhi ayikho enye phakathi kwebanga elingu-10km.
Ungashayela uwele isihlukanisi somgwaqo esiqinile noma isiqhingi somgwaqo emgwaqweni onguthelawayeka kuphela kulezi zimo ezilandelayo:
Awuvunyelwe ukuma emgwaqweni onguthelawayeka ngaphansi kwanoma yiziphi izimo.
Uma uyalwa yiphoyisa lomgwaqo ukuba wenze njalo.
Nganoma yisiphi isikhathi ngaphandle kwempelasonto yePhasika noSuku lukaKhisimusi/uSuku Lokuphana.
Uvunyelwe ukuma emgwaqweni onguthelawayeka ngaphansi kwaziphi izimo?
Izilwane zivunyelwe emgwaqweni onguthelawayeka kuphela uma:
(2) Zeluswa zisuswa kwenye indawo ziyiswa kwenye.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.theRoad.peopleOnTheRo.text: Abantu emgwaqweni

Ngaphandle kwalapho kuyindawo ebekelwe lokho futhi imakwe, awuvunyelwe ukuthengisa noma ukubukisa ngezimpahla emgwaqweni womphakathi noma eceleni kwawo:
  • Endaweni yasemadolobheni:
    • Hhayi ebangeni elingaphansi kuka-180m ukusuka lapho ujantshi unqamula khona umgwaqo ezingeni elifanayo
    • Hhayi ebangeni elingaphansi kuka-180m ukusuka ophawini lomgwaqo oluxwayisa ngejika noma umqansa okuvimba ukubona okungaphambili
    • Hhayi ebangeni elingaphansi kuka-5m ukusuka empambanweni yemigwaqo
  • Akuvunyelwe nhlobo ngaphandle kwendawo yasemadolobheni
Ukuhweba emigwaqweni yomphakathi

• Uma indawo yokuwela yabahamba ngezinyawo ilawulwa amarobhothi, abahamba ngezinyawo kufanele balalele amarobhothi (abavunyelwe ukuwela ngaphandle kwalapho amarobhothi ebavumela).
  • Uma ingalawulwa, abahamba ngezinyawo banelungelo lokuhamba kuqala futhi izimoto kufanele zibame.
  • Abahamba ngezinyawo abavunyelwe ukungena endaweni yokuwela ngokuzumayo ngendlela eyenza kube nzima ukuthi izimoto zime ngokuphepha.
  • Abashayeli kufanele bame noma behlise ijubane uma kukhona abahamba ngezinyawo endaweni yokuwela noma abangena kuyo besuka ohlangothini olufanayo nolomshayeli.
  • Ayikho enye imoto evunyelwe ukudlula imoto eme endaweni yokuwela yabahamba ngezinyawo.
Izindawo zokuwela zabahamba ngezinyawo

• Uma ikhona indlela yabahamba ngezinyawo, abahamba ngezinyawo abavunyelwe ukuhamba emgwaqweni, ngaphandle kwalapho bewela.
  • Uma ingekho indlela yabahamba ngezinyawo, abahamba ngezinyawo kufanele bahambe bebheke izimoto ezizayo, basondele ngangokunokwenzeka onqenqemeni lwesokudla lomgwaqo.
  • Abahamba ngezinyawo bavunyelwe ukuwela umgwaqo kuphela ngemva kokuqinisekisa ukuthi kuphephile, bese bewela ngokushesha ngangokunokwenzeka.
  • Kufanele bawele endaweni yokuwela yabahamba ngezinyawo noma empambanweni yemigwaqo, noma kwenye indawo eqhele okungenani ngo-50m kulezo zindawo.
Izibopho zabahamba ngezinyawo

• Kufanele uhlale esihlalweni sebhayisikili umlenze owodwa ohlangothini ngalunye.
  • Kufanele uhlale ubambe izibambo okungenani ngesandla esisodwa.
  • Awuvunyelwe ukuthwala omunye umuntu, isilwane noma into ebhayisikilini ephazamisa ukubona kwakho noma ukulawula kwakho ibhayisikili.
  • Wonke amasondo kufanele ahlale ethintana nomgwaqo ngaso sonke isikhathi.
  • Awuvunyelwe ukubambelela kunoma iyiphi enye imoto ehambayo.
  • Kufanele nigibele nilandelane emgqeni owodwa ngaphandle kwalapho udlula omunye umgibeli webhayisikili; umuntu oyedwa kuphela ovunyelwe ukudlula ngesikhathi esisodwa.
  • Awuvunyelwe ukwenza omunye umgibeli webhayisikili aphambuke aye ngapha nangapha.
  • Uma kunengxenye yomgwaqo ebekelwe abagibeli bamabhayisikili, kufanele usebenzise leyo ngxenye futhi awuvunyelwe ukusebenzisa enye.
Izibopho zabagibeli bamabhayisikili

• Izilwane azivunyelwe ukuba semgwaqweni womphakathi endaweni ebiyelwe/ivalwe nhlangothi zombili, ngaphandle kwalapho:
    • zigitshelwe
    • zisetshenziselwa ukudonsa inqola
    • zeluswa ziyiswa kwenye indawo
  • Uma welusa izilwane, kufanele uphathe:
    • Ifulegi elibomvu eliyisikwele elingu-300mm ohlangothini ngalunye emini
    • Isibani esibomvu esibonakala ebangeni elingu-150m ebusuku
  • Uma umhlambi unezilwane ezingaphansi kuka-10, ifulegi/isibani esisodwa sanele.
  • Uma umhlambi unezilwane ezingaphezu kuka-10, izimpawu zakho zokuxwayisa kufanele zithwalwe ngaphambi nangemuva komhlambi.
  • Azikho izilwane ezivunyelwe emigwaqweni enguthelawayeka.
Ukwelusa izilwane
Ebangeni elingeqi ku-5m ukusuka engxenyeni yomgwaqo esetshenziswa yizimoto ngaphandle kwendawo yasemadolobheni.
Ebangeni elingeqi ku-5m ukusuka lapho umgwaqo unqamula khona ujantshi wesitimela ezingeni elifanayo noma ejikeni lapho ungakwazi ukubona khona phambili endaweni yasemadolobheni.
Ebangeni elingeqi ku-5m ukusuka ezimpambanweni zemigwaqo endaweni yasemadolobheni.
Awuvunyelwe ukuthengisa noma ukubukisa ngezimpahla emgwaqweni womphakathi noma eceleni kwawo:
Endaweni yokuwela yabahamba ngezinyawo egadiwe, abahamba ngezinyawo bangawela noma nini uma kungekho zimoto ezisondelayo.
Endaweni yokuwela yabahamba ngezinyawo engagadiwe, abashayeli kufanele behlise isivinini noma bame uma kukhona abahamba ngezinyawo abasendaweni yokuwela noma abangena kuyo.
Endaweni yokuwela yabahamba ngezinyawo engagadiwe, izimoto zinelungelo lokudlula kuqala.
Mayelana nezindawo zokuwela zabahamba ngezinyawo:
(1) no-(2) kuphela okungamacala.
(3) kuphela okuyicala.
Akukho kulokhu okuyicala.
Yikuphi kokulandelayo okungamacala:
(1) Ukuthutha izilwane ngemoto elula.
(2) Ukusebenzisa izinqola ezidonswa izilwane ezindaweni zasemadolobheni.
(3) Ukwelusa izilwane emgwaqweni womphakathi.
Uma kukhona indlela yabahamba ngezinyawo, abahamba ngezinyawo kufanele bahambe bebheke izimoto eziza ngakubo.
Endaweni yokuwela yabahamba ngezinyawo engalawulwa, abahamba ngezinyawo abavunyelwe ukungena kuyo ngokuzumayo.
Abahamba ngezinyawo bavunyelwe ukuwela umgwaqo kuphela lapho kuhlangana khona imigwaqo, noma ebangeni elingaphakathi kuka-50m ukusuka lapho.
Imisebenzi yabahamba ngezinyawo ihlanganisa:
(1), (2) no-(3) konke kuyiqiniso.
Ngu-(1) no-(3) kuphela okuyiqiniso.
Ngu-(3) kuphela okuyiqiniso.
Yikuphi kokulandelayo okuyiqiniso:
(1) Uma ingekho indlela yabahamba ngezinyawo, abahamba ngezinyawo kufanele bahambe eduze ngangokunokwenzeka nonqenqema lwesokudla lomgwaqo.
(2) Abahamba ngezinyawo bavunyelwe ukuwela umgwaqo ebangeni elingu-180m ukusuka lapho kuhlangana khona imigwaqo.
(3) Endaweni yokuwela yabahamba ngezinyawo elawulwayo, abahamba ngezinyawo kufanele balalele amarobhothi ngisho noma umgwaqo ungenazo izimoto.
Bagqoke izinto ezibuyisa ukukhanya uma besemgwaqweni womphakathi phakathi kokushona nokuphuma kwelanga.
Baqinisekise ukuthi bahamba kuphela ezindaweni ezibekelwe abahamba ngezinyawo kuphela.
Baqinisekise ukuthi kuphephile ukuwela umgwaqo ngaphambi kokuwela ngokushesha ngangokunokwenzeka.
Abahamba ngezinyawo kudingeka:
Ukugibela ibhayisikili lapho noma yiliphi lamasondo alo lingathinti umgwaqo.
Ukuthwala izilwane ngamabhayisikili abo anyathelwayo.
Ukugibela belandelana emgqeni onabagibeli bamabhayisikili abangaphezu kwababili.
Abagibeli bamabhayisikili abavunyelwe:
Akhombise inhloso yakhe ngokucacile nangesikhathi esifanele.
Aqinisekise ukuthi munye kuphela umgibeli webhayisikili odlula lowo muntu ngesikhathi esisodwa.
Agcine isikhala esivulekile okungenani esingu-1.5m phakathi kwamabhayisikili amabili anyathelwayo.
Lapho edlula omunye umgibeli webhayisikili, umgibeli webhayisikili kufanele:
Ngezikhathi zokuminyana kwezimoto ekuseni nakusihlwa.
Yizimoto ezithutha amabhayisikili.
Ngabagibeli bamabhayisikili ngaso sonke isikhathi.
Uma kunengxenye yomgwaqo ebekelwe abagibeli bamabhayisikili, kufanele isetshenziswe:
Zonke lezi zitatimende ziyiqiniso.
Asikho kulezi zitatimende esiyiqiniso.
Isitatimende (1) kuphela esiyiqiniso.
Uma welusa izilwane emgwaqweni womphakathi:
(1) Kufanele uphathe ifulegi elibomvu (elingu-30mm ohlangothini ngalunye) emini.
(2) Uma umhlambi unezilwane ezingaphezu kuka-50, kufanele uphathe isibani esibomvu ngemuva komhlambi phakathi kokushona kwelanga nokuphuma kwelanga.
(3) Uma welusa izilwane kuthelawayeka, kufanele uphathe amafulegi abomvu ebangeni elingu-150m ngaphambili nangemuva komhlambi.
Zigitshelwe abantu.
Zifakwe ithegi ekhomba umnikazi.
Zisebangeni elingadluli ku-180m ukusuka ezindaweni zomnikazi wazo.
Izilwane zivunyelwe ukuba semgwaqweni womphakathi endaweni yasemadolobheni uma:

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.theRoad.vehiclesOnThe.text:
• Zonke izinqola ezidonswa izilwane emigwaqweni yomphakathi kufanele zibhalwe ngokucacile igama nekheli lomnikazi.
  • Inqola namahanisi kufanele kube sesimweni esiphephile sokusebenza.
  • Isilwane nenqola kufanele kuhlale kulawulwa umuntu (oshayela ngezintambo noma ohola isilwane), ngaphandle kwalapho kuboshiwe ukuze kungakwazi ukunyakaza.
  • Izinqola ezimbili ezidonswa izilwane ezihamba ohlangothini olufanayo azivunyelwe ukuba sebangeni elingaphansi kuka-150m ukusuka kwenye kuya kwenye, ngaphandle kwalapho enye idlula enye futhi izosheshe iqhele kuyo.

• Imoto ithathwa njengelahliwe uma:
    • Ipakwe endaweni lapho kungavunyelwe khona ukuma noma ukupaka
    • Ishiywe endaweni eyodwa emgwaqweni womphakathi noma esiteshini sokuhlola izimoto inganyakaziswa isikhathi esingaphezu kwezinsuku ezingu-7 (endaweni yasemadolobheni)
    • Ishiywe endaweni eyodwa emgwaqweni womphakathi isikhathi esingaphezu kwamahora angu-24 (ngaphandle kwendawo yasemadolobheni)
    • Ingenalo ipuleti lenombolo yokubhalisa noma inepuleti elingelona elayo
    • Idala ingozi noma isithiyo
    • Ingekho indlela yokuhlonza umnikazi
  • Izimoto ezilahliwe zingadonswa noma zigcinwe endaweni esemthethweni yokugcina izimoto ezibanjwe iziphathimandla.
  • Umnikazi kufanele akhokhe zonke izindleko ezihilelekile (ngaphandle kwalapho imoto ibintshontshiwe).
  • Imoto ingathengiswa ukuze kukhokhwe izindleko uma umnikazi engatholakali noma engayilandi imoto.

Amaqembu ezimoto ezihamba zilandelana ziyiswa kumdayisi noma komunye umuntu awavunyelwe ukuhamba ngalezi zikhathi:
  • Ngezimpelasonto, kusukela ngo-18h00 ngoLwesihlanu kusihlwa kuya ku-06h00 ngoMsombuluko ekuseni
  • Ngezimpelasonto ezinde, kusukela ngo-18h00 ngoLwesihlanu kusihlwa (noma ngoLwesine kusihlwa uma uLwesihlanu kuyiholide lomphakathi) kuya ku-06h00 ngoMsombuluko ekuseni (noma ngoLwesibili ekuseni uma uMsombuluko kuyiholide lomphakathi)
  • Ngesikhathi sikaKhisimusi, kusukela ngo-18h00 ngobusuku obandulela uSuku lukaKhisimusi kuya ku-06h00 ekuseni ngosuku olulandela uSuku Lokubonisana Okuhle
Ihlale ingeqi ku-150mm ukusuka onqenqemeni lomgwaqo (itshe lonqenqema).
Ilawulwe ngezintambo zamatomu uma umshayeli esemotweni, noma iholwe umshayeli ohamba ngezinyawo phambi kwemoto.
Ukuze imoto edonswa yizilwane isetshenziswe emgwaqweni womphakathi, kufanele:
(1) Ipakwe endaweni efanayo emgwaqweni womphakathi endaweni yasemadolobheni isikhathi esingaphezu kwamahora angu-24.
(3) Ipakwe endaweni lapho kungavunyelwe khona ukuma.
Kulezi zikhathi ezilandelayo, yiziphi lapho uhide lwezimoto lungavunyelwe nhlobo ukuhamba?

Umzila ongaphansi kophawu ubekelwe amaloli anesisindo esingaphezu kuka-10 tonnes ebangeni elilandelayo elingu-5km.
Umzila ongaphansi kophawu ubekelwe izimoto ezinesisindo esingaphansi kuka-10 tonnes ebangeni elilandelayo elingu-5km.

Uma usemzileni ophakathi kuzodingeka uhlole indawo engabonakali ngezibuko ngakwesobunxele.

Ukuqala komzila owengeziwe ngaphambili.

nav.signs.regulatory.prohibition.questio.text: (1) Ukwenqatshelwa ukwenza okuthile kusho ukuthi awuvunyelwe ukukwenza.

(1) Uma ungumuntu ohamba ngezinyawo awuvunyelwe ukudlula kulo.

  • Iphedali yebhuleki Leli bhuleki laziwa ngokuthi yibhuleki lokusebenza, noma ibhuleki lonyawo. Cindezela iphedali yebhuleki ukuze unciphise ijubane lemoto noma uyimise. Iphedali yebhuleki kufanele icindezelwe ngonyawo lwesokudla kuphela.
  • Iphedali ye-clutch Cindezela iphedali ye-clutch lapho ushintsha amagiya. Iphedali ye-clutch kufanele icindezelwe ngonyawo lwesobunxele kuphela. Uma ungayisebenzisi, kufanele ubeke unyawo lwakho lwesobunxele phansi kwesokunxele se-clutch, hhayi phezu kwephedali ye-clutch. Izimoto ezishintsha amagiya ngokuzenzakalela azinayo iphedali ye-clutch.
  • Induku yamagiya Sebenzisa induku yamagiya ukuze ukhethe noma ushintshe amagiya. I-clutch kufanele icindezelwe uma ushintsha amagiya. Igiya lokuhlehla nalo liyigiya, futhi kufanele ulifake uma ufuna ukuya emuva. Ukhetha amagiya ngokwejubane ohamba ngalo. Lapho uqala ukusuka, kufanele ube segiyeni lokuqala. Ngemva kwalokho, ngokuvamile uma ijubane lakho likhula usebenzisa igiya eliphezulu. Kufanele usebenzise igiya eliphansi lapho wehla umqansa futhi ungafuni ukuthi imoto isheshe kakhulu, noma lapho udinga amandla engeziwe (isibonelo, lapho ukhuphuka umqansa). Lapho imoto yakho imile kufanele ungafaki giya.
  • Ibhuleki lokupaka Leli bhuleki laziwa nangokuthi yibhuleki lesandla. Donsa ibhuleki lokupaka ulinyuse ukuze imoto ihlale imile lapho umile noma lapho ushiya imoto. Lehlise futhi ngaphambi kokusuka. Kufanele usebenzise ibhuleki lokupaka kuphela ngemva kokuba imoto isime ngokuphelele, hhayi lapho usahamba. Sebenzisa inkinobho yokukhulula indlela yokukhiya ibhuleki (inkinobho esekugcineni kwebhuleki lokupaka) lapho ulinyusa noma ulehlisa.
  • Isikhombisi sendlela Induku yesikhombisi sendlela ikhanyisa amalambu ezikhombisi ngaphandle kwemoto yakho. Ingase ibe kolunye uhlangothi lwesiteringi kuye ngohlobo lwemoto. Phusha isilawuli siye phezulu noma phansi (ngasohlangothini ozophendulela kulo isiteringi) ukuze ukhombise abanye abashayeli ukuthi ufuna ukuya noma ukujika kwesokunxele noma kwesokudla. Buyisela isilawuli phakathi ukuze ucime isikhombisi uma usuqedile ukujika (ezikhathini eziningi isikhombisi sizozicima). Ezimotweni eziningi izilawuli zokukhanyisa nokucima amalambu angaphambili nezokushintsha phakathi kokukhanya okuphezulu nokukhanya okuphansi nazo zikule nduku.
  • Isibuko sokubuka emuva Lesi yisibuko sokubuka emuva, noma isibuko sangaphakathi. Bheka esibukweni ukuze uhlole ukuthi kuphephile yini ngemuva kwemoto yakho. Kufanele ubheke esibukweni sokubuka emuva njalo ngemizuzwana engu-5-8 lapho ushayela, nangaso sonke isikhathi ngaphambi kokubhuleka noma ukukhombisa indlela.
  • Isibuko esiseceleni Lesi yisibuko sangaphandle, noma isibuko esiseceleni. Izimoto eziningi zinezibuko zangaphandle ohlangothini lomshayeli nasohlangothini lomgibeli. Bheka ezibukweni ukuze uhlole ukuthi kuphephile yini ngemuva kwemoto yakho. Ungabheka kulezi zibuko njalo ngemizuzwana engu-5-8 lapho ushayela, ngesikhathi ubheka esibukweni esikhulu sokubuka emuva, kodwa kufanele uzibheke ikakhulukazi lapho ushintsha indlela (bheka esibukweni esisohlangothini ofuna ukujikela kulo). Qaphela ukuthi kunezindawo eziseceleni kwemoto yakho ongakwazi ukuzibona kulezi zibuko. Lezi zibizwa ngokuthi yizindawo ezingabonakali ezibukweni futhi kufanele uzihlole ngokuphendula ikhanda lakho ubheke emuva ngamafasitela.
  • Isikali sejubane Isikali sejubane sikukhombisa ukuthi uhamba ngesivinini esingakanani. Bheka isikali sejubane ngezikhathi ezithile ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi awuweqi umkhawulo wejubane. Isikali sejubane ngokuvamile siphinde sikhombise ibanga eselihanjwe yimoto, noma ibanga eliphelele imoto esilihambile.
  • Isiteringi Phendula isiteringi ukuze ushintshe indlela. Lapho ushayela, gcina izandla zombili esiteringini, ngaphandle kwalapho ushintsha amagiya noma ukhombisa indlela ngesandla. Ngalezo zikhathi kufanele uhlale ugcine okungenani isandla esisodwa esiteringini, bese ubuyisela esinye ngokushesha ngangokunokwenzeka. Uma isiteringi besiyiwashi ubungabeka isandla sakho sobunxele ku-10 nesandla sakho sokudla ku-2.
  • Isikali sezinga lokushisa/sikawoyela Lezi zikali zikunikeza ulwazi ngenjini yakho. Izimoto eziningi zinesikali sezinga lokushisa esikutshela ukuthi injini ishisa kangakanani, isikali sikawoyela noma ilambu eliyisixwayiso elikutshela lapho uwoyela wakho usuphansi, isikali sikaphethiloli esikutshela ukuthi unophethiloli ongakanani emotweni yakho, nesikali sokujikeleza kwenjini esikutshela ukuthi injini yakho ijikeleza ngokushesha kangakanani. Izikali eziningi zinezingxenye eziyisixwayiso ezimakwe ngokubomvu ukuze zikukhombise lapho usuqala ukudlula imingcele ephephile. Bheka izikali ngezikhathi ezithile ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi kuphephile yini ukushayela noma ukuthi kudingeka uthathe isinyathelo.
  • Induku yama-wiper Induku yama-wiper ilawula ama-wiper ewindi langaphambili. Ingase ibe kolunye uhlangothi lwesiteringi kuye ngohlobo lwemoto. Kufanele uvule ama-wiper lapho lina ukuze iwindi langaphambili lihlale licacile futhi uqinisekise ukuthi uyawubona umgwaqo ophambi kwakho. Ama-wiper angasetshenziswa futhi ukuhlanza iwindi langaphambili uma uqale ufafaze amanzi kulo (ngokuvamile usebenzisa inkinobho esendukwini yama-wiper). Uma usebenzisa ama-wiper iwindi langaphambili lomile angase aklwebhe kancane futhi ngezinye izikhathi asabalalise uthuli kulo, okwenza kube nzima ukubona.
